programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Orphan Bikes
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Restoring A Used Car
programme.desc: Nick Rutter teaches how to restore headlights, clean engine, remove water spots and other tips on a used car

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Speciality Car Care
programme.desc: Nick Rutter teaches how to restore interior plastic trim, glass cleaning, convertible top care and more

programme.title: Truck U - Warranty is Up
programme.desc: Don’t wait till your factory warranty is up to modify your truck. We’ll show you how to add power and personality while staying street legal.

programme.title: Truck U - Friend Zone
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno take a stock Ram and add bigger wheels and tires. A new grill and makes some new friends along the way.

programme.title: Truck U - Recovery Vehicle
programme.desc: If you’re not prepared to break off-road, you might as well not even play. We’ll show you what “must-have” parts you need to recover your off-road vehicle.

programme.title: Truck U - It’s a Jeep Day!
programme.desc: First, a Jeep Rubicon gets a power convertible top and then our YJ project gets stripped down to the frame.

programme.title: Truck U - Road Rescue-LS Canyon
programme.desc: After a Canyon is saved from the side of the road, Matt and Bruno find the fix in a new crate LS Engine.

programme.title: Truck U - YJ Project part2
programme.desc: Our YJ Project starts going back together with an all new Jeep tub and body. A much needed leaf spring kit and other interior accessories.

programme.title: Truck U - Grand Canyon
programme.desc: Our Canyon truck got a new LS engine, today we give the truck a brake upgrade, new lower stance and turn this into the ultimate sleeper.

programme.title: Truck U - Clean to Custom
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the interior of a C20. Changing out the seats, dash accessories and door panels. We’re going from Clean to Custom on Truck U.

programme.title: Tow Jobs: Tennessee - Welcome to Gatlinburg
programme.desc: Follow Jeff and Kristen Patton in the wild adventures of their towing service in the scenic and sometimes dangerous Pigeon Forge TN. This episode Jeff helps a semi driver get out of a tight turn, move a sly cone manipulator, and get a couple people off a ledge. All in a days work!

programme.title: Tow Jobs: Tennessee - Towventure!
programme.desc: Jeff and Kristen Patton are back. This episode takes the crew to capture a stolen car and rescue a ditched car. All in a days work!

programme.title: Tow Jobs: Tennessee - Towrrific!
programme.desc: Jeff and Kristen meet an irate young man parked illegally then swing over to get a mom out of a predicament. All in a days work!

programme.title: Tow Jobs: Tennessee - Theme Parks and Trailers!
programme.desc: Jeff and Kristen work a food truck out of a windy road at a major theme park then on to a fifth wheel that is eating dirt. All in a days work!

programme.title: Tow Jobs: Tennessee - Creative and Disgruntled Parking
programme.desc: Jeff and Kristen have their hands full with some disgruntled parkers and a creative landing by a pickup needs a little help getting off a ledge.

programme.title: Tow Jobs: Tennessee - Spicy Customers
programme.desc: Jeff and Kristen have a day with a few folks after taking their cars to impound.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Go Fast Collections
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Tigger v. Monster Muscle
programme.desc: Rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6–time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Exotic Car Hunter
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Andruw Jones' Super Jeep
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Jekyll and Hide
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Yellow Taxi
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Peach State Challengers
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Lambo Racer
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Boston's (Un)Common Collection
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - C&O at the Beach
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Kenny Rogers' Family Values
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Motor Masters
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Viva Cuba!
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Chipper Jones' International Car Show
programme.desc: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Fuller's "2029" Majestic Build
programme.desc: Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Fastest Man on Two Wheels
programme.desc: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Power Play: Proline's Search for 3000+ HP
programme.desc: A need for speed in a Sleepy Georgia town has engineers pushing the boundaries to exceed 3000 horsepower.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Turn of the Century Cars
programme.desc: Turn of the century cars?with wooden wheels?at 85mph?oh my!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Hot Wheel's & an Urban Outlaw
programme.desc: Urban Outlaw and designer Magnus Walker weighs in on his beloved Porsche and the legend of Hot Wheels.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Proving Provenance on a One-Off Ferrari
programme.desc: Tracing the origins and solving the mystery of a controversial all-aluminum bodied 512 BBI Boxer Ferrari.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Twin City Turbos
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes Turbo in the Twin Cities; Ferrari Drifter Federico Sceriffo finds a home in Atlanta.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - 470MPH with Custom King George Poteet
programme.desc: Jaguar F-Type Project 7 crosses the Pond.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Art & Oddities at Old Car City, USA
programme.desc: Mustang Mayhem at the big show.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Unsung Hero in the Movie Ford v. Ferrari
programme.desc: Red carpet receptions for a Koenigsegg Regera.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Hollywood's Cars Come to Life at Picture Car Productions
programme.desc: Covert cars that slipped into the U.S.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Rickey Gadson Stares Down a Steep Learning Curve at Rd. Atl
programme.desc: "Go Fast Girl" Katherne Legge's Model A Racer.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Paint Scratch Repair
programme.desc: Nick Rutter teaches how to repair common scratches in automotive paint

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Wheel & Tire Care
programme.desc: Nick Rutter shows you how to properly care for your wheels and tires

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Vintage M37 Engine Swap
programme.desc: When Willie and Kevin find a 1953 M37 sitting in a friend’s garage next to a Cummins 4BT and all the parts needed for an engine swap, they volunteer to provide the labor.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Chevelle Re-Awakening
programme.desc: The guys have a sweet 1970 Chevelle in the shop with a worn-out interior and a problematic cowl induction system seal. Plus, Kevin tackles the daunting task of rebuilding an infamous Rochester Quadrajet Carburetor.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Impala Imposter
programme.desc: Willie stumbles across a beautiful 1966 Impala, but its beauty is only skin-deep. Under the hood are rusty headers, a grimy engine block, and a host of other needed repairs. It’s up to Willie and Kevin to restore this classic to its former glory.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Dropping that C-10
programme.desc: When the guys get their hands on a clean 1986 square-body C-10, they give it a facelift…and a suspension drop. With its brand-new look and stance, Willie and Kevin can’t wait to reveal the truck to its owner.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Pretty Fly for a GTI
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie have an Autobahn edition 2013 MK6 VW GTI in the shop for performance upgrades. With a new turbo kit, exhaust, and a few other improvements, the guys plan to boost this car’s status from “daily driver” to “head-turner.”

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Double Truck Trouble
programme.desc: A friend of Kevin and Willie has not one, but two work trucks that need improvements for hauling heavy loads. Can the guys handle this double-order and finish both trucks in time for the owner to get them back on the job?

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Moab Ready
programme.desc: If you’re headed for the formidable Moab Desert, your Jeep had better be ready for anything. Willie and Kevin are outfitting a Wrangler TJ and a Cherokee XJ to handle the harsh environment of the desert.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - WeatherTech Bound
programme.desc: Kevin hits the road to Bolingbrook, Illinois to find out what it takes to proudly display “Made in America”, as he tours WeatherTech to see how they make all those great American products.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Pop Secrets
programme.desc: Holly helps Mark on the '70 Challenger, Daren annoys everyone with his popcorn and causes Mark to damage a very rare car. Tony D'Agostino, from Tony's Mopar Parts, visits and lends a hand on the '70 sunroof Challenger. Mark lets Holly in on the big secret and Daren reveals a secret of his own.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Let the Sunshine In
programme.desc: Mark gets a portable showroom, the '70 Hemi Charger is dissembled and the team finishes the 1970 Sunroof Challenger. Mark finally reveals his big secret project to the Graveyard Carz team and Royal makes a video tribute to the Sunroof Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Royal Treatment
programme.desc: Mark and the ghouls build out the 440 Super Commando engine for their '70 Plymouth Superbird and install the suspension for the '69 Daytona Charger. Daren finally has enough of Mark's foolishness.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Grand Torino
programme.desc: Body man Derrick becomes an official Graveyard Carz crew member and assists in the disassembly of the rare '67 Plymouth Hemi GTX Convertible. Josh and Daren play "the game" with Mark.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Waltons
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghoulz get a massive sheet-metal order from AMD for their '70 Plymouth Superbird. Meanwhile, the owners of the '72 Charger visit and talk about what made their car so special. Daren gets the offer of a lifetime on his '70 Challenger R/T.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - It's the Great Pumpkin, Goldberg!
programme.desc: It's a Moparween at Graveyard Carz! Just when things couldn't get crazier, Bill Goldberg shows up to go over his '68 GTX Convertible and knock some sense into the guys. He can handle the NFL and the WCW, but can he hold his own at GYC?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Daytona Reborn Pt. 1
programme.desc: Mark is behind on his promise to get Tom Partidge's '69 Daytona Charger finished by the end of the month. The crew kicks into high gear to get Tom's Daytona looking great and out the door.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Daytona Reborn Pt. 2
programme.desc: Mark is behind on his promise to get Tom Partridge's '69 Daytona Charger finished by the end of the month. The crew bands together to do whatever is necessary to fulfill Mark's promise to the owner and bring it back to life.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Top 10 Mopar Muscle Moments
programme.desc: The Ghoulz pay tribute to their favorite moments over the previous seasons. This special episode looks back over seasons 1-3 of Graveyard Carz, but includes all new interviews to highlight some previously unrevealed details.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Elephant in the Room
programme.desc: A 1970 Dodge Charger engine is restored in this Special episode.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Daren and Royal Go Topless
programme.desc: A rare 1970 Charger and a 1970 Barracuda 383 are featured.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - General Disassemble Lee
programme.desc: A 1968 Charger, a 1970 Challenger R/T, and a 1969 Charger are featured.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Mo Money Mo Challengers
programme.desc: A 1972 Dodge Charger is restored.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Drive a Mile in My Shoes
programme.desc: A 1969 Road Runner is featured.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Top Banana Charge
programme.desc: Work on a 1972 Dodge Charger is continued.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Gone Bananas
programme.desc: The story about the 1972 Charger is briefly revisited, and past work leading to its completion is also revisited. Work on the 1972 Dodge Charger is completed and revealed to the owners.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Manifold Destiny
programme.desc: The 1970 Plymouth Superbird work is resumed, and the 1970 Charger R/T collision repair is completed. The 1970 Barracuda Convertible's 383 2bbl. V8 is assembled and painted.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Spoiler Alert
programme.desc: A secret is accidentally revealed by Mark. Mark and Daren visit the local AAMCO Transmissions to watch the overhaul of the 1970 Barracuda Convertible's 727 Automatic Transmission, and then the Barracuda has its A/C box and instrument panel installed. The 1970 Superbird assembly nears completion.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - MoSparring
programme.desc: Automotive parts supplier Tony D'Agostino of Tony's Parts helps the shop get organized, and Mark tests his Mopar knowledge against Tony's. Work on a 1970 Plymouth Superbird is completed.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Common Problems
programme.desc: Nick Rutter shows you how to fix common issues with your automitve finish

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Dust, Bugs and More
programme.desc: Nick Rutter shows you how to remove bugs, polish exhaust tips and safetly remove dust

programme.title: Truck U - Color Match
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno show you how to personalize your Jeep with some paint and fabrication.

programme.title: Truck U - Fishing Trucks
programme.desc: It’s a fishing day on Truck U. Matt and Bruno take two trucks and get them ready to tow with a turbo rebuild and some towing accessories.

programme.title: Truck U - Back to stock
programme.desc: To sell this Longbed C-10, Matt and Bruno need to get it back to stock. They transform the interior back to a factory style bench seat. The exhaust also gets a factory style upgrade.

programme.title: Truck U - Patina Shortbed
programme.desc: Patina C-10 trucks are all the rage. Matt and Bruno leave the paint alone on a 69’ C10 project and give it the fine details it needs to look like a finished look.

programme.title: Truck U - Revived Raptor
programme.desc: It’s back, the new Ford Raptor is here and Matt and Bruno can already make it faster and sound better with aftermarket parts.

programme.title: Truck U - Day in the Dirt
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno find a lowrider truck that has some handling problems. So they fabrication some suspension components and do some interior work.

programme.title: Truck U - Chevy Day
programme.desc: Line ‘em up. It’s a Chevy day on Truck U as Bruno and Matt look at a couple of bowtie trucks in the shop. They do everything from styling upgrades to common problem fixes, and as always, they give you some life lessons along the way.

programme.title: Truck U - Beat the Drum
programme.desc: It’s time to beat the drums off a 1965 F100. Matt and Bruno do a full disc brake conversation and upgrade the master cylinder and booster.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - NAPA Perfect Additions Truck 2
programme.desc: Stacey tackles power gains at the air intake, modifies the computer and replaces the stock exhaust before addressing a 2” front-end suspension lift kit. He moves on to give the truck some extra height and support in the rear of the truck where payload weight can be a serious issue. After the suspension is in place, new wheels and tires bring the truck back down to the ground. Stacey also covers several tools that will help you get that old exhaust out from under your vehicle.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Junkyard Jag
programme.desc: Stacey leads the crew on a hunt for a junkyard Jaguar with a rare engine. Pin-striping legend Von Hot Rod comes to the GearZ studio and lays down some lines on a hot rod guitar. Need to repair or replace the door on your pick up? Stacey’s got a handle on that. A bed lifter system turns a four-man operation into a one-man show. And Stacey’s got a steering column that will keep Falcon owners between the lines. All this and more!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Evolution Worlds Fastest Cat
programme.desc: Stacey tells the story of the legendary Cheetah and how that car was designed to beat Shelby’s famed Cobra. The GEARZ hunt for this iconic race car features the original ’63 Cheetah that Budd Clusserath drove 215 mph at Daytona in ‘64. But the story doesn’t end there, because Stacey gets his hands on a Cheetah Evolution and shows you how to build your own version of this tire shredding cat! After that, you’ll see Steering wheel options from Grant, a serpentine belt system from LMC Truck, and Wizard products to make your vehicle come alive, as well as a quick tip to get things rolling in your shop. All this and more on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Put A Heart In The Cat
programme.desc: Moving deeper into the build of the Cheetah Evolution, Stacey and the crew pull the skin off this cat and start putting in the guts. Overviews of suspension, steering, and brakes get this project up and running. Moving into the heart of this beast, Stacey shows us that good things do come in small packages—the LSX 454 small block is sure to get your pulse rate up. And once the transmission is mounted, look out! Headers follow, and this cat is almost ready to run. Stacey’s tool tech will give you a lift… all this and more on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Cheetah Paws
programme.desc: A road trip, an overview of the Cheetah interior including seat and dash installation, rear lights and a tool tech. The GearZ crew heads out on the prowl to visit a budding young mechanic with a passion for 4X4’s. Back in the garage, Stacey gets in tight with the Cheetah, installing seats and the dash. Selecting gauges and placement are discussed, an AC unit will help keep this cat cool, taillights are fitted, and the side pipes will give this Cheetah some growl! Stacey’s tool tech will keep your project on time and on budget. And Fast Orange cleans more than your hands. All this on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Beaten & Downtrodden
programme.desc: Auction cars and what you might really find out once the car is in your garage: suspension, brakes and electrical concerns. In the current fad of “flipping” cars for cash, Stacey takes on the good, bad, and ugly of a ’66 Biscayne that was bought at auction. Nice looking paint can’t hide the safety issues that are found once this car is put on the lift. From suspension, to brakes, to battery cables… and even down to the lug nuts, this auction beauty turns out to be more of a beast. Safety and sport-style handling are only a few repairs away this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Automotive Icon Turns 40
programme.desc: Stacey and the crew head north to celebrate 40 years of Heartthrob Exhaust and see just how far this company has come since its modest beginnings in a garage. After that we dig into a cracked dash and show how easy it is to replace one yourself with some aftermarket parts from LMC Truck, and then we look at a painless solution will help clean up years of spliced wires and old electrical tape that might be lurking under your hood. It’s simple gearhead stuff that everybody needs to know and it’s only on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Cheetah Gets Her Growl
programme.desc: Stacey digs back into the Cheetah project by finishing up the stance with custom wheels and tires, and then goes through the ins and outs of putting a classic Hilborn fuel injection on a modern LS engine… and the dyno numbers show that the engine likes it as much as you will! After that Stacey sits down with a budding car designer that is making a big impact everywhere he goes and there’s also a tip on the importance of seals and gaskets. It’s all about getting out and turning wrenches, and you’re only gonna find it on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Curves On Wheels
programme.desc: Stacey explores the history of the legendary Jaguar D-type racecar and introduces a D-type Jag from Race Car Replicas that is sure to become a legend of its own. From race wheels to classic spoke wheels with true knock-offs, Stacey looks at options for getting the best look and most rubber on the road with this Jag. A tip might keep you from losing your mind when dealing with lug nuts that don’t want to budge and we talk shop about performance parts for your own cars. So, come hang out while we take on a legendary cat of a different color this week on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - New Bed Old Ford
programme.desc: Stacey and the crew hit the ground running with a late model replacement bed from LMC that’s sure to revive and old Ford farm truck and get it out of the pastures and back on the highway. Then it’s off to show budding Jeep enthusiasts a couple of entry level options they can use when it comes to modifying their vehicle. We get a visit from a couple who learn how to install new seat upholstery. Stacey’s found something cool for all you second generation Camaro owners. And we’re just getting started! So get ready to turn some wrenches on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Gearz On The Road
programme.desc: The GearZ crew and Cornwell Tools team up to help a new shop in Arkansas get some much-needed tools to help them take they’re shop the next level. Then Stacey puts together the final pieces of the Sgt. Rock project by making a trip to France and the beaches of Normandy. Then it’s back to the shop to show you how easy it is to put fuel injection on your muscle car. It’s all here… and only on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Nuts Bolts Building Sgt Rock
programme.desc: Season 10 Starts off with America’s favorite military tribute truck! Sgt. Rock is back and ready for final assembly! Garage Guru, Stacey David, takes us on a tour de force of custom fabrication as he covers all the nuts and bolts of what it’s taken to get Sgt. Rock ready to rumble. Builders of all levels are in for a great show as Stacey tackles one of a kind steering columns, gas pedals and designing a console that not only fits form, but also function. Gauge techs will keep your instrument panels in line. And a quick tip will keep your wires from fraying and your hoses from splitting. All this and more as Sgt. Rock and Season 10 hit the road full throttle.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Sgt Rock Interior Other Details
programme.desc: A custom build can lose some power if the theme doesn’t stay consistent. Stacey shows how to do that by taking you through the process of how to make door and kick panels that keep the rugged military WWII bomber vibe flowing throughout the interior of Sgt. Rock. After that, its some tips on how to fit a radiator and that all-important cooling fan in a place where space is limited. Finally, the gas tank and battery placement are critical on a custom vehicle and Stacey goes through the steps in doing that as well. If you’ve always wanted to build a custom vehicle, this episode is sure to get your fabrication gearZ turning.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Asessing Unfinished Project
programme.desc: Two things are certain in life: death and taxes. We all know what to do with taxes, but what happens when a loved one passes and leaves behind an unfinished project vehicle? How do you know what’s sitting in your garage? And how can you find out? Stacey tackles these questions and takes you on a thorough inventory of an almost finished restoration that was left to a widow when her husband suddenly died. A new dash going into your vehicle? A gauge tech should keep you from crossing your wires. And we’ve got tips that should help with battery relocation and lining up your vehicle’s body panels.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Gearz On The Road - Basic Tools
programme.desc: The GearZ crew mount up and head out to visit a young gear-head whose love of wrenching started with 4-wheelers and has grown to include 4-wheel drive pick ups. Young Adam has a few surprises in store as Stacey visits him in his Dad’s garage and discusses tools, storage and tearing apart things to see how they work. Then, it’s back in the shop as Stacey takes on the big question every gear-head has: What OTHER tools should I have in my box? A look beyond the typical wrenches, hammers and clamps will show you what you may need and what you may not, depending on your project.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Cheetah Body Work Latches Custom Exhaust
programme.desc: The son of legendary car builder, Bill Thomas, talks shop about wrenching, racing and his father’s Cobra Killer…the Cheetah. Then Stacey heads over to Stainless Works to check out how the Cheetah’s custom side pipes, headers and mufflers came together. A Gauge Tech explains the pros and cons of mechanical vs. electric gauges. After that, a Quick Tip explains the proper way to use some of those mystery tools laying around in your tool box.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Old Dog New Truck
programme.desc: Ever wonder why your wife or best buddy won’t step foot in your late model truck? It could be that crusty interior. Tag along as Stacey takes on the sights and smells of an ’83 Chevy in dire need of some attention. From new dash to leather on the bench seat and new carpet in the floor, Stacey shows you what a difference a weekend and some parts from LMC can make. Speaking of trucks, Stacey raises the bar with a bed lifter that will make you the most popular guy in your neighborhood. A new buffer is going to help add some shine to your vehicle and a creeper that’s simply “Magic” is sure to raise an eyebrow or two. Big things are happening in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Reviving An Old Snowcat
programme.desc: Through the years, we’ve had some amazing vehicles featured on GearZ—from elite racecars to the insanity of a V-8 barstool. Well, here we go again! Stacey hauls in a Thiokol Imp that needs some…attention. First things first with this crazy snowcatmobile; we’ve got to see if we can make it run. Follow along as Stacey takes you through the ins and outs of getting a neglected vehicle up and running again. For you performance BMW guys, a tuner from Dinan is going add the horses you’ve been looking for. We’ve got sparks flying, fuel splashing and all kinds of garage mayhem this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - Wiring Sgt Rock
programme.desc: In the world of car building there are few things more ominous than missing titles or VIN numbers. But there is one task that stands out, one that brings grown men to tears, one that is usually lurking behind 100 yards of electrical tape…WIRING. Well hold on tight as Stacey dives head first into wiring Sergeant Rock. That’s right; see how painless Stacey can make wiring the big old truck. Follow along as Stacey moves front to back and gets the Rock one step closer to hitting the road!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz - New AC Old Chevy
programme.desc: With summer in full swing, it’s time to cool down that classic truck of yours. That’s right, roll those windows up and feel the cool breeze as Stacey shows just how easy it is to install this complete AC system from LMC Truck. Now that you’re done sweatin’, let’s take a look at headers and intakes and get that motor performing the way it should. And don’t miss out on the ins and outs of turbos and super-chargers…which one fits your needs? All this and plenty of sparks in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: The Bobby Carpenter Show
programme.desc: 12/10/25: Heisman Trophy Finalists, Ohio State TV Viewership Numbers, Urban Meyer College Football Hall Of Fame News & So Much More!

programme.title: BIGPLAY CLE Show
programme.desc: Shedeur Sanders torches the Titans, yet the Browns still stumble to another heartbreaking loss — and Kevin Stefanski is under fire for more questionable late-game decisions. Plus, Ohio State legend Bobby Carpenter stops by to break down the Buckeyes’ stunning defeat to Indiana and react to the CFB Playoff committee’s final rankings!

programme.title: Bruce Drennan Show
programme.desc: Bruce breaks down the Browns’ disappointing loss to the Titans but still takes time to give Shedeur Sanders his well-earned flowers. He recaps the biggest matchups from a pivotal Week 14 as the NFL playoff picture finally starts to take shape, and he absolutely torches the College Football Playoff committee for choosing Alabama over Notre Dame.

programme.title: Enter The Jungle
programme.desc: The Cincinnati Bengals have been frustrating to watch this season - what is the biggest source of frustration so far? James Rapien and Andrew Fox Miller each share their top grievances, and they react to the news of Trey Hendrickson opting for surgery with a six-week recovery timeline. Has Trey played his final snap as a Cincinnati Bengal? Plus, the Bengals waived second-year wide receiver Jermaine Burton. The guys react to the decision to cut Burton and discuss what to make of the team's FanDuel odds in Week 15.

programme.title: The Matt Fontana Show
programme.desc: Despite the Browns opening Deshaun Watson’s practice window, Matt lays out why he still doesn’t expect the quarterback to take a snap this season. He sees clear improvement from Shedeur Sanders in his second start, but insists the rookie still has a long road ahead to prove he’s a true franchise QB. Plus, the crew gears up for the Big Ten Championship as the Buckeyes get set to battle Indiana for the No. 1 seed in the College Football Playoff.

programme.title: The Top Dawgs Show
programme.desc: 12/9/25: Browns Spoil Shedeur Sanders’ Career Day With More Special Teams Miscues, Coaching Concerns & So Much More!

programme.title: Full Court Cleveland
programme.desc: Despite an ugly home loss to Portland, the crew isn’t anywhere close to panicking about the Cavaliers. They look ahead to Cleveland’s upcoming matchups with the Spurs and Warriors, power rank the NBA’s top rivalries and break down Oklahoma City’s historic 21–2 start to the season.

programme.title: The Snap Count
programme.desc: Charlie and Trai break down the Steelers’ nightmare home loss to the Buffalo Bills, examine Mike Tomlin’s standing with the franchise he’s long led, analyze the offensive line’s struggles, and gear up for Pittsburgh’s Week 14 showdown with the Baltimore Ravens.

programme.desc: For nearly 50 years Giorgio Piola has been the foremost technical journalist in Formula 1. He has attended more Grands Prix than anyone in history. This film looks at the remarkable career of this legend.

programme.title: IndyCar vs Formula 1 car: Technical Comparison - IndyCar vs Formula 1 car: Technical Comparison
programme.desc: Which is faster: Lewis Hamilton's Formula 1 car, or Scott Dixon's Indycar? Both have had major success in their respective championships, but how different are the two machines? Using our latest 3D animations, Jake Boxall-Legge breaks down everything there is to compare Indycar and Formule 1 cars, from aerodynamics, power, tyres, fuel and more.

programme.title: How Formula 1 Setups Change For Downforce Vs Power Tracks - How Formula 1 Setups Change For Downforce Vs Power Tracks
programme.desc: What makes a Formula 1 downforce track different to a power track? We've all heard the terms before, but different tracks require vastly different car setups to get the maximum advantage around a lap. But what are these requirements? Jake Boxall-Legge dives into why Imola, Monaco, Silverstone and Monza all require different changes to a car to succeed across the board.

programme.title: The banned Lotus that wasn't actually very good - The banned Lotus that wasn't actually very good
programme.desc: The twin-chassis Lotus 88 is considered the last truly ground-breaking design attempted by Colin Chapman, but we never found out how fast it could have been because it was never allowed to race. However, as Giorgio Piola reveals, while rivals feared the concept, its drivers were not convinced the 88 would have delivered on the track. How did it work? Jake Boxall-Legge guides you through Chapman's complex idea to make ground effect cars more user-friendly.

programme.title: Everything You Need to Know About TYRES in Motorsport - Everything You Need to Know About TYRES in Motorsport
programme.desc: Tyres play a vital role in getting the driver from A to B in a race. Here's the rundown of the variety of tyres and how they are used across different motorsports. programme.desc: Catch all the highlights from Spa-Francorchamps, the third round of the 2025 Belcar Endurance Championship.

programme.title: Nissan Skyline GTR - Nissan Skyline GTR
programme.desc: The original ‘beast from the east’, the Nissan Skyline GT-R is an icon for power, speed and advanced Japanese automotive technology. With straight-6 engines capable of being tuned to over 1000bhp, 4WD, intelligent torque-splitting differentials, rear-wheel steering and enough electronics to keep a space station going, the R-32, R-33 and R-34 models are mechanical ‘tour de forces’ .

programme.desc: Experience the excitement of the Mixed Split Pro Age pickleball match on Championship Court. This video features a unique pairing of new partners Schull and Endara, who are familiar with the heat and come from a grinding three-game win in their last match. They face off against the formidable Lee Whitwell and Kafka. With Lee Whitwell's impressive hands and athleticism, and Kafka's hard-hitting forehand and topspin drives, this is a matchup you won't want to miss. Get ready for incredible rallies and a display of top-tier pickleball as these pros battle it out.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 - US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 - Men's Senior Pro Doubles - Bronze Medal
programme.desc: Scott Crandall & Jose Derisi taking on Stefan Andren & Rick Witsken for Bronze Medal in Naples, Florida.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2023 - Picklebowl 2023 – Mixed Doubles Final – Yates & Wuerffel vs Bright & Hafez
programme.desc: In the exciting championship match of Picklebowl 2023, pro pickleball player Kyle Yates teams up with Picklebowl host and former NFL quarterback Danny Wuerffel to challenge the fierce duo of Anna Bright, a top female pro and former collegiate tennis star, and Ameen Hafez. This charity event brings together athletes and celebrities representing their alma maters in a competitive battle for the Picklebowl trophy. Commentary by Dave Fleming and special guest Marcellus Wiley highlights the skill, strategy, and drama on court. Watch intense rallies, strategic plays, and hear insider insights as these top players compete for the title. Don’t miss the dynamic energy and social spirit of pickleball in this must-see final.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 360 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 104 World Series Kaunas, Lithuania part 1. Starting the night is a lightweight match between Tiago Mendes and Champion Mindaugas Narauskas. Nika Khelaidze takes on Vitoldas Jagelo in an MMA Bushido contest, Jussi Pirttikangas faces Erikas Golubovskis, Nicola Kisari, making his pro-debut, and Nauris Lukosiunas face off in a Romania versus Lithuania matchup. Also watch Bruno Borges from Portugal take on Lithuanian Samuelis Sorochovas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 361 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 104 World Series Kaunas, Lithuania part 2. In this episode Soslan Gasiev faces former heavyweight champion Tomas Pakutinskas, up and comers Arnestas Naujokas and Gustas Dimsa faceoff in the ring, Poland's Jakub Kwasniewski faces charasmatic Vitas Karosas from Lithuania, experienced fighters Filip Rzadek and Ignas Barysas look to make their match fight of the night.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 362 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 104 World Series Kaunas, Lithuania part 3. First up Moldovanian Nicolai Garbuz faces Mantas Kondratavicius of Lithuania in an MMA Bushido bout and Sasa Polugic takes on Mantas Rimdeika for some heavyweight action. In the main event Simon Santana and Matas Pultarazinskas head to the ring for a featherweight bout with the World Championship up for grabs.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 432- Shamrock 361
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 361 from Kansas City, Missouri. In the opening match, Ethan Hall steps into the cage with Bryson Osborne and Kylen Snider takes on Torry Moore in the welterweight division. Also on this card, Soy Migo and Misael Monarrez are set to take the challenge. In the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks faces Willie Henderson, making his pro-debut in a kickboxing bout.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 348 - CFC 13 Non Ducor, Duco
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 13, Non Ducor Duco from Sao Paulo Brazil. This episode features a four man tournament. In the first match of the night Fabrico Martins faces Bruno Tavares and in the second match Leandro Rodrigues faces Antonio Monteiro. The two winners will move on to the main event.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 357 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 27 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 27 part 1 from London. In tonight's episode of BKB, Beau Besley from Wales takes on Aaron McCallum from Nottingham, Johnny Jones battles it out with Mark Handley and Polish Szymon Szynkiewicz faces American Eric Olsen. Also watch as Martin Refell and Lionel Levitchi take to the ring, Luke Kelly, making his BKB debut, faces Callan Harley and Lawrence Tracey faces off against Mason Shaw.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 358- Bare Knuckle Boxing 27 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 27 part 2 from London. Starting off this episode of BKB, Patrick Nash takes on Jack McLean, Ben Hatchett making his BKB debut faces Robin Deakin and in a championship bout while Dave Thomas and Steven Evans battle it out for the belt. Watch as Emil Markic and Albert Scamp clash in the ring while Gavin Curragh and Marley Churcher take to the ring vying for the title belt. Also in the main event Craig Morgan takes on Carlos Alexandre in a BKB and BYB cross promotion clash.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 439 - KOK - Best of part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings from Lithuania. Walid Poyan faces Emilijus Kaganovicius in the Lightweight division and Ilir Bega steps into the ring with Ignas Pauliukevicius for a Heavyweight bout. Also in this episode Ivans Kozecenkovs and Deividas Zamba take to the ring for what's expected to be a highly intense battle. Marius Kutauskas, making his pro-debut is matched up against Samuelis Sorochovas. Watch as Likas Lapinskas takes on Arturs Skabarnieks in an MMA Heavyweight bout and in a Lightweight matchup, Morroco's Anas Hilboui takes on Afghanistan's Tamim Shariffi in a very evenly matched fight. Also, in a Lightweight bout, Christiano Silva faces off against the much more experienced Mindaugas Narauskas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 453 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions IV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions IV part 2 from The Fox Theater in Pomona, California. Starting off with a female bout, undefeated fighters Olympian Brianda Cruz and Susana Lopez step into the ring to fight for their perfect record. In the main event is another battle of the undefeated as David Romero takes on Pedro Valencia who is coming off of a three year hiatus.

Starting us off is a match between Jonny "The Zombie" Lawson and Ryan McCann and in a female bout, with both fighters making their BKB debut is Stephanie Dy versus Danni Lee. Also faceing off are Tyrone Eliffe and Richard Samuels and George Taylor and Andrei Nastac take to the ring to battle it out in a heavyweight bare knuckle match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 380 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 2 from London. Watch as Kamil Sokolowski and Bri Morrow trade punches in a challenging matchup. Peter Hayes and Adam Grogan face off in the ring and Tony Barratt takes on Ryan Barrett. Also Ionel Levitchi of Romania and George Hillyard from London take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 381 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 3 from London. Dan Gittens and Marcin "Psycho" Kosiak step into the ring while Eryk Majda faces Kevin Greenwood with the British heavyweight title on the line. Romanian Bogdan Suru takes on Welsh Ash Williams and in the main event, two BKB veterans Scott McHugh and Tony Lafferty head to the ring for the World Flywieght Title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 418 - Country Box 29
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Jimmy Adams Promotions, Country Box "Where Music Meets Boxing" from Nashville at the famous Troubadour venue. In this episode of Country Box 29, Raquan Ashby faces Ryan Diaz and Oliver Mcall is back at age 59, with 39 KO's the former WBC heavyweight champion (knocking out Lennox Lewis) takes on Gary Cobia. In the main event, the more experienced Vaughn Alexander tests the undefeated Maidel Sando. Plus singer Krista Dudley plays an original song.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 424 - KOK 122 Riga
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK 122 from Riga, Latvia. In the first matchup Piotr Cybulski and Aleksandrs Zeleznakovs head to the ring for what's expected to be an intense kickboxing bout. Also in this episode Savvas Kagkelidis and Ilija Ivanov faceoff and in a Light Heavyweight bout Jan Pelak and Kristaps Zile step into the ring for a bout under boxing rules. In another Light Heavyweight matchup Deniss Jermakovs takes on Kristaps Zutis in a rapper versus fighter in an MMA contest. In the main event Rodrigo Mineiro and Zaurs Dzavadovs battle for the Interim Welterweight Championship belt.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 355 - CFC Mursa Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 16 Mursa part 1 from Malta. Next up two Brazilians battle to move on in the tournament as Joao Luis Nogueira takes on Felipe Douglas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 356 - CFC Mursa Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 16 Mursa part 2 from Malta. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 393 - Centurion FC 19 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 1 from Rio de Janeiro. First up Darlan Santos takes on Junior "The Golden Boy" Dias in an intense matchup with contrasting styles. In a dynamic clash, Helio "Big Boy" Nunes, known for his aggressive style and strong finishing abilities, takes on Rafael Silva, who will rely on his stand-up striking skills in a dynamic clash. Expect an intense, high-energy bout between two rising Brazilian fighter as Milson Castro Barao faces William Lima Malvadeza in the first Grand Prix semi-final fight. In the Grand Prix semi-final 2 Walber Dos Anjos Timoteo faces Paulo Henrique Laia in what should be a well-rounded and technical fight followed by the Grand Prix final match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 396 - Centurion FC 19 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 2 from Rio de Janeiro. In this Boxing Extreme matchup Paulo Pizzo faces Anderson Dos Santos Berinja in a clash of striking versus grappling and two well rounded fighters take to the cage next as Mauricio Faccao faces Marcos Babuino. In an what's expected to be an action packed MMA match, Yury Neles Seu Jorge looks to end the match early with a KO against Luciano "Lulu" Oliveira.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 434 - Red Owl BoxFest XV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XV part 1 from Houston, Texas. In the first match, Stephen Acosta takes on Brian Soto in a four round super flyweight bout. In the 8 round co-main event undefeated Antonio Perez faces veteran boxer Alex Martin in the Superlight weight division

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 438 - Red Owl BoxFest XV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XV part 2 from Houston, Texas. In the Featherweight division, Emmanuel Carrillo Jr. takes on Jordan Najar. In the main event, undefeated Bantamweights Khalid Twaiti and Emanuel Moreno face off in an eight round matchup after an contentious weighin.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 440 - Shamrock FC 364
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 364 from Kansas City, Missouri. On the card tonight, Robert Fichtner takes on fan favorite Anthony Dooley in the Bantamweight division. Caleb Williams and Brynn Heathcock faceoff for a Catchweight bout. In the Light Heavyweight Division, undefeated Glendal Whitney puts his record on the line when he steps into the cage with Kameron Kemp in the co-main event. In the main event Timehin Babaloa takes on Dan Olajiga in what's expected to be a fight of attrition.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 421 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2 from Oradea, Romania. In the Super Middleweight division Steven Mendes from France takes on Romania's more experienced Andrei Ostrovanu with 42 wins (24 by KO). In an ISKA Cruiserweight World Title match, Vasileios Karagkiozis and Sebastian Lutanic vie for the belt in a Greece versus Romania bout. Also, in an open weight division Tolea Ciumac and Bogdan Nastase face off in a David versus Goliath match

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 422 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3 from Oradea, Romania. Up first in an ISKA Super Middleweight World Title match, Vinicius Bereta of Brazil takes on Adrian Maxim of Romania with the belt on the line. In the Colossal Division with a total of 723 pounds in the ring, Cristian Anheliuc and Sandu Lungu face off. The ISKA Super Middleweight Wordl title is on the line when Camaroon's Brice Kombou takes on Romania's Andrei Leustean.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 37 part 3 from London. In the main event, watch defending champ, Jimmy Sweeney as he faces James Connelly, world lightweight champion.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 402 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features an 8 man tournament in the cruiserweight division. The champion will face the challenger in the ISKA world cruiserweight championship. Fighting in the quarter finals are Alessio Sarbu vs Sebastian Lutaniuc, Becali Bodescu vs Marius Rotaru, Costi Mocany vs Danut Hurduc and Alex Virlan vs Ionut Busuioc.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 403 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2 from Targu Jiu, Romania. Continuining the 8 man tournament in the crusierweight division, this episode features the semi-finals. In a SuperFight open weight division bout Vajtan Shanava, Spanish champion for three consecutive years, steps into the ring with Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi, Romanian favorite with a record of 62 wins and 31 by KO.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 404 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features the 8 man tournament final for the DFS crusierweight belt. But first, stepping into the ring are Alexandros Chrysochoidis and Bogdan Nastase with 55 victories, face off in a Superfight in the light heavyweight division. Next up two champions, Calin Petrisor, the defending ISKA champion and Valentin Mavrodin the defending DFS champion take to the ring for a title fight with the ISKA and DFS belt unificaiton on the line in the middleweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 409 - Fighters Only 16th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 16th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas with host Chael Sonnen. This prestigious event celebrates outstanding achievements in MMA. Featuring numerous categories the event highlights the dedication and talent within the MMA community. Winners are determined by fan voting making this award show a unique reflection of the sport's global fanbase. Presenters include Bubba Jenkins, Brody Malone, Jake Ellenberger, Belal Muhammad, Ian Bohen, Derek Stevens, Arianny Celeste, Randy Couture, Caroline Pearce, Jon Anik, Kaz Egan, Megan Anderson, BJ Baldwin, Nina Drama, Will Yun Lee and Neal McDonough with special appearances by Jelly Roll, Dave Farra and Mark Coleman.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XII part 1 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. Also in this episode is the Shadow Fightgoods 140 pound tournament final, Elijah Williams and Dion Jones vye for the win.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XII part 1 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. In the main event two undefeated welterweights Tahmir Smalls and Seantorius "Hardhead" Martin face off. Smalls with the reach advantageand 8 KO's looks to defeat Seantorius with 6 KO's under his belt.

In the main event, watch defending champ, Jimmy Sweeney as he faces James Connelly, world lightweight champion.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 402 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features an 8 man tournament in the cruiserweight division. The champion will face the challenger in the ISKA world cruiserweight championship. Fighting in the quarter finals are Alessio Sarbu vs Sebastian Lutaniuc, Becali Bodescu vs Marius Rotaru, Costi Mocany vs Danut Hurduc and Alex Virlan vs Ionut Busuioc.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 403 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2 from Targu Jiu, Romania. Continuining the 8 man tournament in the crusierweight division, this episode features the semi-finals. In a SuperFight open weight division bout Vajtan Shanava, Spanish champion for three consecutive years, steps into the ring with Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi, Romanian favorite with a record of 62 wins and 31 by KO.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 404 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features the 8 man tournament final for the DFS crusierweight belt. But first, stepping into the ring are Alexandros Chrysochoidis and Bogdan Nastase with 55 victories, face off in a Superfight in the light heavyweight division. Next up two champions, Calin Petrisor, the defending ISKA champion and Valentin Mavrodin the defending DFS champion take to the ring for a title fight with the ISKA and DFS belt unificaiton on the line in the middleweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 409 - Fighters Only 16th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 16th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas with host Chael Sonnen. This prestigious event celebrates outstanding achievements in MMA. Featuring numerous categories the event highlights the dedication and talent within the MMA community. Winners are determined by fan voting making this award show a unique reflection of the sport's global fanbase. Presenters include Bubba Jenkins, Brody Malone, Jake Ellenberger, Belal Muhammad, Ian Bohen, Derek Stevens, Arianny Celeste, Randy Couture, Caroline Pearce, Jon Anik, Kaz Egan, Megan Anderson, BJ Baldwin, Nina Drama, Will Yun Lee and Neal McDonough with special appearances by Jelly Roll, Dave Farra and Mark Coleman.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 408 - Red Owl BoxFest XII part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XII part 1 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. Also in this episode is the Shadow Fightgoods 140 pound tournament final, Elijah Williams and Dion Jones vye for the win.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 410 - Red Owl BoxFest XII part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XII part 1 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. In the main event two undefeated welterweights Tahmir Smalls and Seantorius "Hardhead" Martin face off. Smalls with the reach advantageand 8 KO's looks to defeat Seantorius with 6 KO's under his belt.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 382 - Shamrock FC 352
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 352 from Kansas City. In the bantamweight division, Anthony Dooley Sr. takes on Brendan Vice, undefeated and defending welterweight champion Matt Triboletti steps into the cage with striker Jordan Kryfka "The Human Backpack" looking to steal the title. In the co-main events watch as Glendal Whitney takes on Tim Garrett in a light-heavyweight bout and Tyson Hicks and Thomas Thatcher take to the cage in the welterweight kickboxing division. In the main event the more experienced Jacob Akin and Drake Heitfield trade punches in a bantamweight bout.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 447 - Up Next Fighting 13 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. First up, striker Bryen Dao takes on brawler Ferrin Marcelin in the featherweight division and Aiden Ingram steps into the cage with Steve Mora in a bantamweight bout. Also on this card Carlos Figueroa looks to break Artem Afanasenko's undefeated streak. In the main event, Christopher "Taco" Padilla puts his lightweight title on the line when he faces his toughest opponent yet with five time UFC veteran Justin Janyes.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 451 - Up Next Fighting 13 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Starting off in the bantamweight division, Jonathan Powell steps into the cage with veteran grappler Will Holguin. In a featherweight bout, striker Jonny O'Neill takes on wrestler Eudardo Zarate with the winner moving on to a title opportunity. Also watch as Adam Garcia and Zachary Kraschinsky take to the ring in a lightweight bout. With two titles on the line in the featured bout, the rising star UNF Featherweight title and the California State featherweight title in the rising stars division, Stone Lavelle and his opponient Sean Crenshaw battle it out for the two belts.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 1 from London. Also faceing off are Tyrone Eliffe and Richard Samuels and George Taylor and Andrei Nastac take to the ring to battle it out in a heavyweight bare knuckle match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 380 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 2 from London. Watch as Kamil Sokolowski and Bri Morrow trade punches in a challenging matchup. Peter Hayes and Adam Grogan face off in the ring and Tony Barratt takes on Ryan Barrett. Also Ionel Levitchi of Romania and George Hillyard from London take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 381 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 3 from London. Dan Gittens and Marcin "Psycho" Kosiak step into the ring while Eryk Majda faces Kevin Greenwood with the British heavyweight title on the line. Romanian Bogdan Suru takes on Welsh Ash Williams and in the main event, two BKB veterans Scott McHugh and Tony Lafferty head to the ring for the World Flywieght Title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 418 - Country Box 29
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Jimmy Adams Promotions, Country Box "Where Music Meets Boxing" from Nashville at the famous Troubadour venue. In this episode of Country Box 29, Raquan Ashby faces Ryan Diaz and Oliver Mcall is back at age 59, with 39 KO's the former WBC heavyweight champion (knocking out Lennox Lewis) takes on Gary Cobia. In the main event, the more experienced Vaughn Alexander tests the undefeated Maidel Sando. Plus singer Krista Dudley plays an original song.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 424 - KOK 122 Riga
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK 122 from Riga, Latvia. In the first matchup Piotr Cybulski and Aleksandrs Zeleznakovs head to the ring for what's expected to be an intense kickboxing bout. Also in this episode Savvas Kagkelidis and Ilija Ivanov faceoff and in a Light Heavyweight bout Jan Pelak and Kristaps Zile step into the ring for a bout under boxing rules. In another Light Heavyweight matchup Deniss Jermakovs takes on Kristaps Zutis in a rapper versus fighter in an MMA contest. In the main event Rodrigo Mineiro and Zaurs Dzavadovs battle for the Interim Welterweight Championship belt.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 16 Mursa part 1 from Malta. Next up two Brazilians battle to move on in the tournament as Joao Luis Nogueira takes on Felipe Douglas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 356 - CFC Mursa Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 16 Mursa part 2 from Malta. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 409 - Fighters Only 16th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 16th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas with host Chael Sonnen. This prestigious event celebrates outstanding achievements in MMA. Featuring numerous categories the event highlights the dedication and talent within the MMA community. Winners are determined by fan voting making this award show a unique reflection of the sport's global fanbase. Presenters include Bubba Jenkins, Brody Malone, Jake Ellenberger, Belal Muhammad, Ian Bohen, Derek Stevens, Arianny Celeste, Randy Couture, Caroline Pearce, Jon Anik, Kaz Egan, Megan Anderson, BJ Baldwin, Nina Drama, Will Yun Lee and Neal McDonough with special appearances by Jelly Roll, Dave Farra and Mark Coleman.

programme.title: Out of the Cage - Chris Smeltzer
programme.desc: Chris Smeltzer's journey into MMA began 12 years ago, through Karate. Chris' work as a School Bus driver fits perfectly with his MMA lifestyle, allowing him the flexibility to train throughout the day, as well run a karate school for kids. The martial artist lifestyle helped bring structure to all areas of Chris' life. He believes he has become a better person through Martial Arts, and he makes the mental distinction between between being a fighter and being Martial Artist. He prefers the standup game feels he is progressing well to being an all around fighter with his BJJ Blue Belt.

programme.title: S1E2 Moto
programme.desc: The journey continues as we follow two brothers on their 2,300-kilometer adventure across Morocco. Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa as they experience vibrant cities, breathtaking beaches, and the adventure of a lifetime. Plus, enjoy bonus footage of Jeremy Seewer. With 50 podiums, 11 victories, 17 race wins, and five FIM Motocross World Championship silver medals, his record is remarkable — yet his story goes far beyond the numbers.

programme.title: S2E1 Moto
programme.desc: Celebrate the women of GoPro, including British rally driver Catie Munnings, who rose to fame after winning the FIA European Rally Championship Ladies Trophy at just 18. Watch snowboarder Alina Hight who made history as the first to land a double backside alley-oop rodeo in a halfpipe competition. Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S3E1 Moto
programme.desc: GoPro Athlete and Formula 1 star Daniel Ricciardo teams up with Race Service Co-Founder James Kirkham for an unforgettable ride through Los Angeles. With eight Grand Prix victories and 32 podiums to his name, the Honey Badger spends his day off behind the wheel of supercars like the Ford GT, racing past Beverly Hills, the Sunset Strip, and into the winding roads of Benedict Canyon. Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E1 NHL After Dark
programme.desc: In this episode, NHL and GoPro team up to show the game from the perspective of some of hockey’s greatest players. On NHL After Dark, Detroit Red Wings forward Tomáš Tatar puts his street hockey skills to the test with challenging stickhandling drills. Pittsburgh Penguins center Evgeni Malkin, three-time Stanley Cup champion and 2012 Hart Memorial Trophy winner, showcases his smooth hands and technical mastery as he takes on drills that look simple but are far from easy. Chicago Blackhawks defender Duncan Keith elevates target practice to an art form while outmaneuvering his opponents with precision and speed.

programme.title: S1E2 NHL After Dark
programme.desc: In this episode, NHL and GoPro join forces to capture the game through the eyes of hockey’s best players. Vancouver Canucks duo Daniel and Henrik Sedin showcase their legendary on-ice chemistry through a series of unconventional drills. Philadelphia Flyers center Claude Giroux returns for his second episode, using lightning-fast hands and impressive physicality to outmaneuver his opponents. Colorado Avalanche forward Gabriel Landeskog powers through defenders and scores hard-hitting goals that put our cameras to the ultimate test. New Jersey Devils goalie Cory Schneider takes on unique drills that double the challenge and push his skills to the limit.

programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks.
