programme.title: Sight Unseen
programme.desc:
In the premiere episode of Modern Homestead, Janna Breslin and Evan DeMarco take the plunge into a world they've never known before, as they embark on a journey that promises to challenge their limits, expand their horizons, and redefine their very notions of homesteading. What begins as a bold venture to buy 120 acres in the picturesque Tennessee landscape quickly transforms into an eye-opening experience that neither of them could have anticipated.
The episode kicks off with excitement and a sense of adventure as Janna and Evan, an unlikely pair consisting of a cover model and a scientist, reveal their audacious plan to create a thriving homestead capable of withstanding even the most unexpected challenges - including a potential zombie apocalypse. Armed with enthusiasm and a determination to master the art of self-sufficiency, they set out to build their dream oasis where they will source their own water, grow their own food, generate energy, and construct their own shelter.
However, as the saying goes, reality often has other plans. What Janna and Evan initially perceive as a straightforward path to their modern homesteading vision takes an unexpected turn. As they explore their new purchase, they encounter challenges that leave them both baffled and humbled. The land they imagined to be a canvas of endless possibilities presents them with a unique set of obstacles they hadn't foreseen.
Amidst the breathtaking beauty of the Tennessee landscape, the duo faces unexpected revelations. The landscape itself is both enchanting and unpredictable, with its own stories etched into every rock and tree. With each twist and turn, Janna and Evan's perceptions of their journey shift, and they find themselves relying on each other's strengths more than ever before.
As they dive deeper into their new reality, the couple discovers that their homesteading adventure is about more than just mastering survival skills; it's about embracing the unknown, learning from failures, and celebrating triumphs no matter how small. The episode captures the candid moments of frustration, laughter, and perseverance as they navigate through the challenges of homesteading.

programme.title: Chili Bathroom
programme.desc:
In the second episode of The Modern Homestead, Janna and Evan's journey gets off to a chaotic start when Janna wakes up with something very dangerous in her hair.
With Janna's hair emergency as a wake-up call, Evan swings into action and calls in the experts. They bring in a food security systems designer and a homesteading expert to help them navigate the complexities of their new life.
Simultaneously, the couple recognizes the pressing need to transform their cabin into a more safe, functional and comfortable space. This includes building a much-needed bathroom for those moments when Evan has a bit too much chili.
Episode two brings laughs, excitement and and the recognition that building the Modern Homestead might not be as easy as they thought,

programme.title: Breaking The Mold
programme.desc: In this episode of Modern Homestead, Janna and Evan start their cabin renovation but discover what they think is black mold. While awaiting a contractor, they visit a Florida homestead for an education on growing food.

programme.title: Water of Love
programme.desc: Janna and Evan address the water issues on The Modern Homestead. After attempting to fix the leaking ponds and address the well water problem, they take a trip to South Carolina to learn about some amazing technology that ensures they will always have water.

programme.title: Baa Baa
programme.desc: Janna and Evan catch an early flight from back from California to begin working on the greenhouse. Janna's lofty ideas for the green house, which include a full bar, put the project well over budget and way behind schedule. They turn to repurposing materials from an old hoop house Butch found in a field. Janna gets distracted by baby goats.

programme.title: Boats and Hoops
programme.desc:
After days filled with construction challenges, cabin renovations, and a daunting hoop house project, Janna and Evan decide it's time to unwind and recharge. Evan surprises Janna with a getaway to beautiful Lake Norris in Tennessee, hoping to enjoy a relaxing weekend away from the homestead.
With a speed boat and an innertube, relaxing is the last thing happens. Janna loses her top, her bottoms, her Whoop and her hair tie all in one run on the tube before learning to waterski.
Amid the chaos and wardrobe malfunctions, the couple finds joy in shared laughter and unexpected adventures, proving that even in the midst of homesteading challenges, the most treasured moments are often the ones unplanned and full of laughter.

programme.title: Func Shui
programme.desc: Evan has one last surprise up his sleeve for Janna before their return from a relaxing trip to the lake. It's llamas! They visit a llama farm, then return to find Jeff brought a construction crew for cabin renovations. The arrival of the construction crew adds a new layer of excitement to the homestead's transformation. Together with the construction crew, they begin to see their dream home taking shape in ways they never imagined.Evan invents a new design technique.

programme.title: Talk Dirty to Me
programme.desc:
In this episode of Modern Homestead, the challenges keep piling up for the Janna and Evan. The cabin, once a symbol of their dreams, is under siege from nature itself. As they open up the walls for much-needed renovations, they discover an alarming infestation of black mold. But that's not all; the back wall of the cabin has been entirely consumed by termites and carpenter ants, presenting a threat to the entire structure.
Jeff takes on the daunting task of tackling these issues, while Janna and Evan shift their focus to building the gardens, preparing for the upcoming planting season. Evan gives a crash course in the science and art of soil.
The episode also features a cozy fireside chat, where Butch and Jeff pick up their guitars for a special "Modern Homestead Unplugged" acoustic set.
In "Talk Dirty to Me," the homesteaders are reminded that a homestead is more than just a house; it's a living, breathing project that requires their unwavering dedication and resourcefulness.

programme.title: Creeping Thyme
programme.desc: Janna and Evan continue to face challenges with the inside of the cabin but are able to get the outside corked using a new building material. Friends and family show up to help with the outside gardens, getting them closer to food security.

programme.title: Guns, Bows and BigFoot
programme.desc: With termite damage causing significant setbacks in their cabin renovation, Janna and Evan decide to channel their frustrations into a friendly yet competitive shooting and archery contest. This episode not only showcases their skills but also addresses the importance of security on the homestead from both a technical and practical standpoint. Amidst the competition, with a special prize for the winner, they also encounter a surprise introduction to a potentially influential neighbor on their property, adding an intriguing twist to their journey.

programme.title: Domestead
programme.desc: In the season 1 finale, Janna and Evan provide an intimate and heartfelt recap of their first year in off-grid living, a journey filled with both triumphs and trials. This episode stands as a milestone, marking the completion of their 30-foot dome, a significant achievement that allows them to finally sleep on their homestead.

programme.title: Detroit River Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis M. Creech and Paul Laurain as they capitalize on Lake Erie's largest Walleye migration into the Detroit River. The Spring Walleye Run in Detroit is absolutely epic and you won't want to miss this non-stop action of some total hog walleyes in this episode of Michigan Fishing Nation TV!

programme.title: Spring Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Melanie, Diana, Andrew and Paul for some Spring Walleye jigging action on the St. Clair River in Port Huron, Michigan! Jigging is when you catch walleye in the rivers using an up and down motion while simultaneously using your trolling motor to stay vertical while navigating through the current. It's one of the most challenging ways to fish. You won't wanna miss these awesome fish!

programme.title: Lake Huron Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Wife Melanie, their boys Aiden and Colton, along with Uncle Adam, as they travel to Fort Gratiot, Michigan, to get after some Great Lakes Walleyes on Lake Huron. This area and episode really showcases the beauty of Michigan's Great Lakes, you won't wanna miss this! Thanks for tuning in to Michigan Fishing Nation TV.

programme.title: St. Clair River Sturgeon Fishing
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Mel and Paul as they target Michigan's oldest Prehistoric Fish in Algonac, Michigan, the mighty Sturgeon! Imagine hooking into a freshwater shark and nearly snapping your rod in half during the fight! Dive below the depths of the St. Clair River at night with Curtis and the gang! You will not want to miss this action packed episode of Michigan Fishing Nation TV.

programme.title: Smallmouth Bass Fishing
programme.desc: Join Curtis as he tries Kayak Fishing for the first time near Michigan's Hidden Gem, "Turnip Rock" in search of some Smallmouth gold! Once they start casting, you will not believe the non-stop Lake Huron Smallmouth Bass action! This is a trip for the record books that you will not want to miss.

programme.title: River Trolling & Whipping for Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, wife Melanie, Brother-in-law Adam and Father-in-law Fred for an amazing episode on Michigan's St. Clair River from Marysville as they troll down the river for Walleye during the day and transition to the local tactic of "whipping" at night! By the end of this episode, you'll have everything you need to start cracking that whip and have a boat-load of walleyes!

programme.title: Motor City Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Melanie and Paul as they venture across the Detroit River between Michigan and Canada (Ontario) in search of some icy cold Walleyes for the fryer! This is the video you'll want to watch to learn how you can get on the river and jig up some tasty walleyes!

programme.title: How to Jig for Michigan Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Adam and Paul as they scout for Walleye near the Blue Water Bridge in Port Huron Michigan and Sarnia in Ontario, Canada. This is a great how-to video on jigging for river walleyes.

programme.title: Winter Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Curtis and Paul venture out between Michigan and Canadian waters of Ontario in search of some tasty Winter Walleye on the St. Clair River.

programme.title: Walleye Jigging Mayhem 2025
programme.desc: Curtis, Adam and Andrew venture out into the icy St. Clair River to pull in some hog walleyes!

programme.title: Hawaii Wild Boar And Spearfishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the island of Maui to hunt for wild pigs and do some spearfishing. You won't believe the double shot Kyle makes on pigs!

programme.title: Alaska Sockeye Salmon
programme.desc: Kyle Green heads to Alaska to fish for sockeye salmon with his cousin William, and buddy Mike. They catch limits every day and enjoy the most beautiful scenery in the world!

programme.title: High Mountain Chukar
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the mountains in Eastern Washington to target chukar. This frustrating upland bird makes for a great adventure!

programme.title: Channel Islands Fishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads out to the Channel Islands National Park 30 miles offshore to fish for halibut and whitefish. The amount of fish they see while spearfishing is incredible!

programme.title: Hawaii Axis Deer
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the island of Maui to hunt Axis Deer! Jeff gets a giant buck and Kyle embarks on an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: Snake River Cutthroat
programme.desc: Kyle Green heads to the Snake River in Idaho to fish for rainbow trout and work with the DNR to help save the cutthroat trout. The management of this fishery is a touchy subject, but the team follows the science to get real answers!

programme.title: The Great Washington Bird Hunt
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to Washington State to hunt for ducks and quail. Lots of birds and lots of laughs in this high-action episode!

programme.title: Inland Lake Ice Fishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team targets northern pike through the ice with their buddy Scott Slater. The big one they catch is a beauty!

programme.title: Noodling Giant Catfish
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads down to Texas to try their hand at noodling. Did they catch a new Texas state record blue cat?

programme.title: Manistee River King Salmon
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors heads to the Manistee River in Northern Michigan to target King Salmon! Jeff catches an absolute monster!

programme.title: Prehistoric Paddlefish
programme.desc: Kyle Green travels to Oklahoma to fish for a prehistoric dinosaur called the paddlefish. He never expected the action to be this good!

programme.title: Giant Lake Sturgeon
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team head out on the St Clair river to target giant lake sturgeon with their buddy Mitch. The monster Kyle caught was way over the slot limit!

programme.title: The Florida Kingfish
programme.desc: Kyle Green travels to Florida with his Sea-Doo FishPro Trophy to target kingfish, snook and giant Tarpon! He meets up with Frank Viola and Bri Andrassy who take Kyle out of his freshwater comfort zone. They go 7 miles out to sea, fish under docks, and everything in between. Don't miss the biggest fish we have ever featured on our show!

programme.title: THE MAINE MOOSE
programme.desc: The chances of getting drawn for moose tag in the state of Maine is slim to none. However, since the winter tick problem has been getting so bad in moose populations the department of fish and game has had to open up more opportunity for hunters to kill these ticks with moose hunting. How does that work?

programme.title: ALAKSA SOCKEYE SALMON
programme.desc: The last frontier is not a place for the faint of heart. It's full of natural resources that can harvested if you're willing to go on an adventure for it! Kyle and his cousin, William, go out for the sought after, sockeye salmon. Kyle is learning a new method of fishing that could be frowned upon if practiced in other places of North America. This method is called flossing.

programme.title: THE SNAKEHEAD FISH
programme.desc: A fish that heals you? Many cultures believe that the snakehead fish has healing capabilities that can even cure cancer. That is part of the reason why this invasive species ended up in the North American waterways. Kyle and Jeff visit Maryland to understand how the locals have turned this invasive species into a positive!

programme.title: THE MYSTERIOUS 10,000 ISLANDS
programme.desc: What do Native Americans, Pirates and Drug Smugglers all have in common? The 10,000 Islands of South West Florida. Kyle heads out on an adventure to see if he can catch, cook, camp and learn a few things about these mysterious chain of islands that many before him had somehow survived on.

programme.title: REMOTE LAKE ICE FISHING
programme.desc: What snowmobiles and Trout have in common? They both have thriving populations in Idaho. Kyle meets up with Idaho biologist, Bret High. Bret takes Kyle deep into the mountains of Idaho to see how well the trout are doing in the remote lakes that were previously stocked by Idaho fish and game.

programme.title: THE TEXAS GATOR HUNT
programme.desc:
Snakes, rotten chicken, gators, and Texas Heat. Kyle, Jeff and Ryan visit their buddy in Texas to harvest these prehistoric lizards.
Only one problem, Kyle and Jeff made a bet...

programme.title: BISON BISON BISON
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors heads to Oklahoma to learn a history lesson about the North American Bison.

programme.title: UPPER PENNISULA TROUT ADVENTURES
programme.desc: Kyle, Jeff and their friend, Scott, spend some time in their home state. They visit places that were surrounds with Native American legends, giant cliffs and of course some trout fishing.

programme.title: INVASIVE CARP DISASTER
programme.desc: Kyle heads to South Dakota to see for himself how bad the invasive asian carp problem is. With the help of his friend Erin "Chummy" Riibe, they head out onto the water to blowfish for these invasive fish.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #1 - Robbie Kroger "In the Blood"
programme.desc: What is Blood Origins? Robbie Kroger tells us about his philosophy on what Blood Origins means and relates it to his story. A South African native, he has come to the United States and is looking to his past to learn more about what hunting meant to him and his family for generations.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #2 - Keith Polk & Lake Pickle "Threaded"
programme.desc: Everyone has a story… For Lake & Keith, it is one of mentorship, lifelong friendship, and a passion for sharing their love of hunting with younger generations. Through a program bringing the hunting experience to younger generations, they came to know more about their love of the outdoors and being a role model. The tradition then lived on through their experiences like many other traditions in the hunting community.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #3 - Ryan "Koup" Kuperus "Giants"
programme.desc: Ryan "Koup" Kuperus is a retired USMC Gunnery Sergeant. After a devastating Humvee rollover accident, his femur and back were both broken. The nature of his accident and experiences overseas left him searching for answers on how to adjust to life at home. The outdoors and hunting provided him with an escape. Now, he works on engaging other veterans and people going through experiences like his to hunting and the outdoors. Using the experiences of nature and hunting traditions, he works to give others the healing he found in the peacefulness of the wilderness.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #4 - Craig Corsi "Giants"
programme.desc: Craig Corsi lives the hunting life dedicated to the outdoors. A retired USMC 1st Sergeant, the path Corsi has chosen for himself is based on the tenants of family, hunting, and dedication to the outdoors. Through his business and lifestyle, he can invest in others and bring more experiences to those around him looking to understand the hunting tradition.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #5 - Cuz Strickland "Heart"
programme.desc: As one of the originators, Cuz Strickland has the insight to tell a story more rooted in hunting and tradition than most. He was focused from experiences at a young age on how hunting and humanity came together. He aims to always make that experience available to young people. He wants the hunters of tomorrow to see the outdoors and love of the forests from a lense of understanding and respect.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #8 - Leonard Bentz "Fathers"
programme.desc: Your story is likely unique to you, just as my own story is probably unlike yours.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #12 - Derek Harris "Memories"
programme.desc: From an early age Derek was raised to be a different breed of hunter. It wasn't all about the kill. His dad instilled in him that being outdoors is an experience. Being outdoors is about making memories and relationships with others. He would take these same values and instill them into his little brother. As he matured Derek took this one step further, by becoming a professional outfitter in New Mexico, and took it as a profession to take others hunting and into the outdoors to make their own memories

Phil the Blind Guy joins us and Tommy's lovely wife Mackenzie! We go out and fish for whitefish in the morning and the wind blew us off, then we went out to the Apostle Islands and jig for lakers!
#bigfish #laketroutfishing #howtocatchlaketrout

programme.title: How to Catch GIANT Summer Walleyes
programme.desc:

#walleyefishing #walleye #howtocatchwalleyes

programme.desc: On this week's episode we headed up to Door County to fish for some GIANT summer smallmouth bass! Sturgeon Bay is know for their exceptional smallie fishing and amazing views! We used a variety of techniques such as paddletails, tube jigs and ned rigs to target these fish. Tune in for tips on location and lures to put more bass in your boat!

Simple set ups with a jig and minnow were all we needed to put a pile in the boat!

programme.title: Backwater Blue Gills on the Mississippi

We had some crazy warm weather and it opened up the river so we had to take a flat bottom boat onto the ice to get on the fish! When we got on the fish, we smoked em! Huge gills and jumbo perch were on the menu that day and we couldn't get enough!

programme.title: Turkey Hunting (Exciting Turkey Hunt)
programme.desc: This year we can't get enough turkey hunting! We asked our good friends from Warrior Boats, Kent and Jacob Andersen to join us in turkey camp! First we started out with Lucy and had some awesome action, we had 3 birds come in and start beating up the half strut jake decoy! 15 minutes later we finally got a good shot and Lucy capitalized! We headed out to the same blind in the morning with Kent and Jacob and had 2 more big toms come in to beat up our decoy!

programme.title: Fishing Madison Perch with BIG B! (MONSTER PERCH)
programme.desc: This Week on Larry Smith Outdoors we make a trip down to Madison to hook up with our friend Brian Zupke! We put the smack down on these huge perch! Definitely the place to be if you're looking to find some OVER average perch!

programme.title: Whitefishing with Our Sponsors
programme.desc: This week we take our sponsors out white fishing in Green Bay to thank them for their support throughout the year! We definitely put the smackdown on these fish!

programme.title: Northern Wisconsin WHITEFISH! (how to ice fish)
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head up to Minocqua by our good friend Jeff Van Remortel to fish for northern Wisconsin Whitefish! After doing a number on the whitefish we target a few late afternoon walleyes!

programme.title: Iowa Perch and Yellow Bass (Spawning eelpout)
programme.desc: On this episode we head over to Ruthsben, Iowa to fish with Legends Guide Service for perch, yellow bass and walleyes! The conditions were a little nasty and the cold front had the fish somewhat shut down but we still had an amazing day! Eelpout are one of the best eating fish in the lakes and put up one heck of a fight!!! Tune in as Larry shows you how he catches, clean, and cooks eelpout!

programme.title: Late Ice MONSTER Pike Fishing
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head up to the bay of Green Bay to chase late ice MONSTER pike! With pike moving into shallow bays and getting ready to spawn we set a monster spread of tip ups in hopes for GIANT! Good friends, good times and lots of laughs on this awesome day!

programme.title: KILLER Crappie Bite
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors.. While Larry was on the farm planting trees we got a call from our friend Brian Zupke of Big B's Guide service and he was on a killer crappie bite! Hold onto your Hineys because Brian and Caleb are DIALED IN!

programme.title: INSANE Tarpon Fishing!!!
programme.desc:
On this week's episode we hopped on an airplane down to Marco Island to chase the king of fish, Tarpon! Guided by Dave Nelson of Lifetime Fishing Outfitters we had the experience of a lifetime!!!
Dave is one of the most knowledgable and hard working guides we've ever fished with. No doubt he is the person you want to go with if you want to chase these fish!

programme.title: How to Catch and Clean BULLHEADS
programme.desc: On this week's episode we got a call from our good friend Terry to go fish for some bullheads! When I was a kid i use to fish for bullheads with my dad all the time! They are relatively easy to catch, easy to clean and great to eat! Check it out as I show how to catch, clean and cook some bullheads!

programme.title: Coyote Hunting with THERMAL SCOPES
programme.desc: Coyotes are some of the smartest and most cunning animals you can hunt! Their amazing eyes, eyes and sense of smell can usually keep them safe. However, we decided to upgrade our arsenal with a little help from thermal scopes and infrared scopes. Check out as we do a little population control on our local coyotes!

programme.title: FIshing for Walleyes on a RAFT
programme.desc:
On this week's episode we join our good friend Kurt Duxbury on the Wolf River on his fishing raft! Many locals love this tradition and they can be extremely successful at helping you bag your limit of fish on the Wolf River!
Using cane poles and Wolf River rigs with fatheads and shiners we were able to put some nice fish on the raft!

programme.title: Little Girl Shoots First Turkey with CROSSBOW
programme.desc: On this week's episode, we joined 3 youth hunters on the Wisconsin youth turkey hunt! Two of the three girls had some luck and an unforgettable experience! The youth turkey hunt is an awesome opportunity to have kids get a good chance at a turkey before everyone else and these girls closed the deal!

programme.title: Trolling for Post Spawn Walleyes Tips+Tricks
programme.desc: Then we head out with Lightning Lance and Brian Clairmont for some night trolling for walleyes! They break down some tips and tricks for you to catch some more fish!

programme.title: Catching GIANT Spawning Bluegills

Remembering good catch and release ethics is EXTREMELY important for spawning bluegills to protect the population and future genetics for years to come!

programme.title: How to Catch Perch in Summer! (Tips-Tricks)

programme.title: Brook Trout Adventure (Catch/Clean/Cook)

programme.title: Larry's BIGGEST BUCK! (Minnesota Muzzleloader Hunt)
programme.desc: On this weeks episode we head over to Minnesota for a muzzleloader deer hunt! Larry is in the right place at the right time and shoots his biggest buck ever!

programme.title: All About The Kids

programme.title: Slow down for more birds
programme.desc:
You set the pace in the field, and if you're in a rush so is your dog. That means less time in a scent cone and more missed birds.
Scott Linden of Wingshooting USA TV shows you how, and explains why, you should dial things down a bit when it comes to covering a field or covert.
If you want more tips on dog training and bird hunting, go to: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Hunting dog tailgate exam, part one
programme.desc:
Your best hunting partner needs some TLC ... especially after a hunt. wingshooting USA TV host Scott Linden provides the first part of three, helping you check him from nose tip to tail and ensure he's healthy, safe, and ready to go the next day.
Today, it's all about your dog's coat. We'll cover why it's important to get him off the ground, how "training" for the exam is critical, and what to look for from injuries to parasites. Your dog will stay healthier, well-rested, and ready to go the next day.
You'll also see some fun and exciting bird hunting footage from a hunt where the tailgate exam became crucial.

programme.title: Take a newcomer hunting - here's how
programme.desc:
Safety first, but then what? Author and TV host Scott Linden outlines some ways to encourage, motivate, and then help a new hunter on their first hunt.
From weather to shooting tips, to interacting with the dog, and what really counts on the hunt, Scott offers suggestions to ensure everyone has fun.
For more tips on hunting, dog training, and finding places to go: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Identify your best prospect for a new hunter
programme.desc:
Picking the right new hunting partner is an art and a science ... and while there's no wrong way, some ways are righter than others. Author/TV host Scott Linden outlines some tips on finding the right person, how to set expectations, and what to tell them - and show them - before you make "the ask."
For more tips, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: The new-hunter best recruiter is your dog!
programme.desc:
Who doesn't love hunting dogs? The magic of their performance, excitement, and the adrenaline rush of a flush! One easy way to start a new hunter is to invite them to help train your dog.
Simple, short, convenient - there's no downside. And who wouldn't appreciate a little help with dog training?
Plus, some cool footage of a hunt with excellent dog works.
For more on starting a hunter, finding places to hunt, and dog training, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com.

programme.title: Ideas for finding new places to hunt
programme.desc:
Find upland birds on waterfowl production areas, and more tips on accessing public hunting areas are two of the topics ... as well as a great place to headquarter: Huron, South Dakota.
Watch some exciting bird hunting footage, too.
Find more information at www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Tailgate exam, part 2: wheels
programme.desc:
Part two covers your dog's "wheels," his feet. Enure a fantastic hunt tomorrow by keeping his feet healthy and injury-free with these step-by-step, toe-by-toe instructions.
Geet the entire exam in written form at HappyJackInc.com.

programme.title: Be nice, see where it gets you
programme.desc:
Walk-in hunting spots are not always easy to find. Here's an example of how to find them and the bonuses you might find along the way.
From hunting with a pro baseball player, to finding a black pheasant, to discovering new public-access spots in Huron, SD, there's a few lessons here.
Plus, some fun footage of a South Dakota pheasant hunt.
For more tips, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Peak performance on Day Two: feed your dog strategically
programme.desc:
In the first 20 days of this season, my wirehair Flick had already hunted over 200 miles. He still scratches the RV door every morning, eager for another day of chukar chasing and quail quests.
I manage to keep up (mostly) with coffee and pain reliever. Flick, on the other paw, gets his stamina from Dr. Tim's dog food.
If your dog hunts multiple days in a row, it might be worth a look at how important food is to his performance. I asked Doctor Tim Hunt to share his thoughts on that, but first, a hunting story.

programme.title: Tailgate exam, Part 3: His steering wheel
programme.desc:
Okay, we've checked his body, his feet. But the tailgate exam isn't over until you've checked a dog's head – the steering wheel of your hunting machine. Like your truck, you're not getting very far without one! Put off that tall cold one for a couple more minutes. You'll have a fully-functioning hunting partner for the next day … and you won't die of thirst!
In this video, I'll show you where to look, what to look for and why ... and also how to remedy most common issues that might kibosh your next day's hunt, from getting stuff out of eyes and ears, to ensuring weeds and crud stay outta those places and more!
I'll take you step-by-step through all the deep, dark places that harbor danger and irritation on your dog's head so he's ready and rested for the next day's hunt.
And if you need remedies for any of the problems outlined, you can find them at www.happyjackinc.com.

programme.title: Get high, become a better bird hunter
programme.desc:
Not like that! I mean, boost your altitude - even just a bit - and you'll be able to keep a closer eye on your dog. If you're paying attention, you'll have a crucial half-second extra to get ready for a safe, sure shot.
I'll show you how - what you might use to get "up there" a little, what to look for in your dog's behavior, and why it's worth the effort.

programme.title: What's in my vest ... and why
programme.desc:
"Don't leave home without" is more than a cliche' from a TV commercial. What should you take on your next bird hunt, for you and your dog? Here's some advice on critical stuff, and what you might leave home ... without jeopardizing your safety or comfort - or you're dog's!
Somewhere in my personal vest is everything I need to shoot as well as possible (no smart remarks, please), stay found or get found, keep my dog safe and healthy, and help me survive a night or two in an emergency.
I'll show you all of it, and how to keep it from getting lost somewhere in the middle of nowhere!

programme.title: Your dog hurts - here's why
programme.desc:
I seem to be getting a lot of related questions since the season ended – most about aches and pains in our four-footed hunting buddies. And us!
The difference is, dogs won't show it like we do, with gripes and limping, complaints and wincing. They are way too loyal and hard working. It's why we love 'em.
You might already know this, but veterinarians tell me dogs seldom show pain. What they do, is slow down. Their pace in the field drags, they're slow to get out of their crate.
Maybe they won't jump onto your tailgate or training table.
That's probably arthritis, and it affects most dogs over eight years old. But here's the scary part: twenty percent of dogs show signs as early as one year old.
In this video, I'll show you how to prevent arthritis, manage it if your dog already has it, and what to avoid so he doesn't get it prematurely!

programme.title: Fuel your bird dog's peak performance ... but NOT with carbs!
programme.desc:
We hunt to watch our dogs work. So, stand by for plenty of that. But first, let me relate my last season. I tracked Flick's mileage. He averaged twenty-five miles a day, over almost fifty days in the field. I'm a lousy shooter, and okay trainer … so I'll attribute his stamina to my dumb luck, and his performance dog food.
If you want to watch your dog in the field day after day, heed some of the advice I got from Doctor Tim Hunt, a veterinarian, sled dog racer, and developer of the food Flick eats. He says the fuel you put in your dog directly impacts his ability to hunt hard, especially on a long hunting trip. He should know. His food has powered a bunch of Iditarod winners … and my guy Flick.
In this video, you'll learn what the key ingredients are in a dog food, how they work, and why. Hint: the most important component in your dog food is probably NOT what you think it is.

programme.title: Bird dog training: one (baby) step at a time
programme.desc: Dogs learn in a linear fashion, so in this video Scott shows you how important it is to break a complex task into smaller pieces. Training one piece at a time ensures a compliant, happy, peak-performing hunting buddy.

programme.desc: This week on The High Road YouTube Channel, we're showing you an early run of one of our shows airing during the 2020 season! Keith heads to Hog Wild Adventures with his 9mm Carbine, Pulsar thermal equipment and his Streak Ammo to light up the night! He'll be gunning down pesky critters and feral hogs with this awesome combo. He'll also be tracking down hogs with his awesome Air Venturi Recluse air gun topped off with a thermal scope.

programme.title: .50 cal MANIA! Hunting Exotics in Texas
programme.desc: .50 cal mania!!! America's favorite caliber is the star of the show this week on "The High Road with Keith Warren"! We're at the world class Double Drop Ranch just outside of Houston, Texas hunting for exotics with some of the best and biggest guns on the market, all of which are .50 cals! Keith will be starting with a 500 Smith & Wesson Revolver and going after a bull ram sheep - this handgun packs a punch! After that, Matti will be going after her long awaited very first Axis buck with her favorite rifle: the .50 cal Dragon Claw air rifle made my Seneca. Last but certainly not least, Keith is busting out the .50 BMG he got from his friends at Superior Outfitters and going on an Aoudad hunt. See how effective these various .50 cals are at taking down wild game. For more information on hunting exotics at Double Drop Ranch, visit: https://doubledropranch.com.

programme.title: Spot n Stalk Bison Hunt!
programme.desc: On this episode of "The High Road with Keith Warren", Keith and Matti meet up with long time friend Austin Rohr of Superior Outfitters at the Double Drop Ranch. Double Drop Ranch has a variety of game and is known for their exotic species- but today, we are going after one of North America's largest native species- The BISON! First we'll be going on a hog hunt in the dead of the night armed with the industry leading Pulsar thermal gear. Then, Austin will be taking his first ever American Buffalo. The American Buffalo is the largest animal in North America, making it incredibly challenging to successfully hunt. Watch as Austin challenges himself and fills his family's freezer with delicious bison meat!

programme.title: The Hunt for Ol' Smokey
programme.desc: This week on The High Road with Keith Warren, Keith and his cameraman Johnny are headed out to Gobble N Grunt Outfitters in Nebraska on a whitetail hunt. Its late season Muzzle Loader, so the guys are going to be hunting food sources and hoping to catch the secondary rut. Guiding Keith and Johnny on this hunt is long time friend of The High Road, Mike Zmek who is as determined as he is friendly. The weather is cold and the deer are moving but the tension rises as this hunt gets down to the wire. You wont want to miss this!

programme.title: Plains Game vs. Air Rifles
programme.desc: Today on "The High Road with Keith Warren", Keith Warren and Matti Tackett are back in the Eastern Cape of South Africa with Huntershill Safaris. They've decided to bring along their trusty .50 cal "Dragon Claw" air rifle with them. It's Matti's first time to Africa and she's on a mission to spot and stock two beautiful, challenging plains game animals: the Blue Wildebeest and the Zebra. Keith's been to Africa many times before, but he's zeroed in on taking down the peskiest nuisance of all in Africa: the BABOON! Watch The High Road take on Africa with the power of air. For more information on this air rifle, visit airventuri.com.

programme.title: .50 BMG Bull Giraffe Hunt
programme.desc: This week on "The High Road with Keith Warren," Keith is doing something that has never been done before; he's taking a bull giraffe with a .50 BMG! Then, we're stopping by Conroe Taxidermy to show you what they can do with this awesome animal.

programme.title: .50 BMG Kudu and Baboon Hunt
programme.desc: It's not every day that you hunt KUDU in South Africa with a .50 BMG! Watch as Keith's producer, Johnny Piazza, trades his camera for one of the biggest rifles known to man. Although Johnny will have to carry the 35 pound gun across the toughest terrain in Africa, it all pays off in the end as Johnny fulfills a lifelong dream of taking on THE GREY GHOST!

programme.title: Daddy/Daughter Exotic Hunt Extravaganza
programme.desc: Today on "The High Road with Keith Warren," we're celebrating the relationship between Daddies and Daughters! We'll be heading to the Northern Texas Hill Country at Stone Creek Ranch going after blackbuck and fallow deer. The daddies and daughters we'll be featuring are Kyle and Shaylee Clouse from Liberty Safe and Tyler and Taylor Tiller from Timber Creek Outdoors!

programme.title: A Sportsman's Life
programme.desc: Luke Bow hunts the Dale River Ranch followed by cooking up some Shepard's pie on the old Dutch kettle/Larry visits Double Nickle Taxidermy/Jeff heads out to put some venison in the freezer

programme.title: A Sportsman's Life
programme.desc: Larry, Daughter Theresa and Son in Law Lance prepare for the upcoming deer season along with some pond fishing/Luke makes hog chili/ Jeff and Luke fish with Guide Tony Pennebaker on Lake Tawakoni for Blue Catfish

programme.title: Hunter Ed Certified! / Our Wyld Life / EP3
programme.desc: In EP 3, Kristy and Yogi collect some water samples from the new property to have tested. The baby mules are back and they're as wild as ever...the training is such a rewarding process! Kristy and Yogi also spend three days getting their Wyoming Hunter Ed certification, as well as their Instructor Certification! Exciting times...this is, Our Wyld Life!

programme.title: Western Hunting & Conservation Expo / Our Wyld Life / EP1
programme.desc:
Welcome to Our Wyld Life where host Kristy Titus and her husband, Yogi, take viewers along on their day-to-day lives, full of adventure. After relocating to Wyoming, hunting, outdoor and shooting sports recreation are literally in their backyard. The couple is truly making their home on the range while developing their new homestead and enjoying life in the cowboy state.
In our premiere episode, we show you a little bit of what it's like being a Wyoming resident, in the winter. After a tough start, Kristy makes it a great week with familiar faces and many new ones, in what is one of the most fun shows of the year! If you didn't make it in 2023, it's a must to attend next year! Also, you'll be introduced to the newest (and longest eared) members of the family! Kristy shows off her baby mules...lots more of the mules to come! When they aren't out on an adventure trekking deep into the backcountry with their horses and mules, you'll find them preparing for the next opportunity to do so.
Our Wyld Life presents the journey of life out west in Wyoming.

programme.title: DOUBLE DOUBLE
programme.desc: Chris and Parker Gade and other family members head to Wyoming on a DIY antelope hunt!! They had a double double good time!!

programme.title: BIG POND BRUISERS
programme.desc: Lee Schneider and Zach Haas are heading back out onto Lake Michigan with Captain Fluffy in search of king salmon, coho, rainbows, or whatever else wants to bite!! Once we hit that magic hour, the action was non-stop!!!

programme.title: What are the Chances
programme.desc:
Luke Cranney has been guiding sheep in Idaho for 11 years, and packing in Alaska for 2. Everything lined up, and he got the chance to go on a hunt of his own. However, unlike many sheep hunts they had no scouting or plan in place. This was a true adventure hunt filled with bad weather, beautiful animals, and uncanny good luck. Follow Luke, Austin and Brady on an experience they will never forget.
Visit huntinfool.com for all your western hunting needs. Hunt Consulting | Magazine | Draw Odds | 3D mapping | Outfitter Referrals | License Application | Hunt Giveaways
Instagram: @huntinfool_official Facebook: @thehuntinfool Twitter: @huntinfool

programme.title: COLORADO BIGHORN EXPERIENCE - with Aaron Derose of Dillinger River Outfitters
programme.desc: After 23 years of applying for the Colorado Bighorn Aaron Derose has the opportunity of a lifetime. We hope you enjoy as Aaron pursues one of the truly most majestic animals in North America.

programme.title: The Nosler Experience, Alaskan Moose with Dillinger Outfitters
programme.desc: Garret Wales and John Nosler go after Giant Alaskan Moose with Dillinger Outfitters.

programme.title: Largest Public Land Ram in Utah 194"
programme.desc: We were very fortunate to play a roll in capturing Kyle Ekker's hunt on film. Kyle Ekker grew up in Green River Utah where he developed his love of hunting, chasing mulies on the Book Cliffs. He has worked for the Emery County Sheriff's Office for 30 years where he is currently employed as a captain. He has been a member of the Utah FNAWS for the last 10 years and through this he is able to share his passion for the outdoors & wild sheep. In December of 2015 he drew the highly coveted Rocky Mountain Bighorn Sportsman's permit. This tag gave him the opportunity to hunt sheep from the beginning of September to December 31st on almost any open units in the state. He hunted every opportunity that he had he could in pursuit of his dream ram. On November 30th things came together for him and he was able to harvest a very magnificent ram. With an unofficial green score of 194" this ram will be the largest public land ram ever killed in the state of Utah.

programme.title: Leopard Hunting at Mt. Galai Tanzania
programme.desc: Monster leopards that are rarely hunted in the mountains above the Serengeti are chased by host J Alain Smith and his Masai trackers as they try and lure a legendary domestic goat killer that has been wrecking havoc on the local village from his lair at the top of Mt. Galai!

programme.title: Cape Buffalo Charge
programme.desc: Black Death is an accurate description of the very deadly Cape Buffalo. One of Africa's "Big 5", this massive beast is mean, unforgiving, and a very dangerous animal to hunt! The thrill of the stalk of one of these monsters fuels J. Alain Smith's passion for big game hunting like no other! Every hunt is different, every hunt is risky, and every hunt is completely thrilling! Watch now and follow the adventure!

programme.title: 63" Greater Kudu Hunt
programme.desc: J. Alain is on the hunt for a 63" Kudu, one of the biggest ever taken on camera! However, the Greater Kudu of Africa is called the "Grey Ghost" for a good reason! Will Africa disappoint?

programme.title: Kentucky Opener, The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Jared Mills and Grant Noble head to Kentucky for their first hunts of the year. Brandon Whitten begins the quest for Buster, and Bella Reed takes a big framed 8 point during the Iowa youth season.

programme.title: Travel Quest Ep105: Yap
programme.desc: This remote Pacific island is a diver’s paradise and we take advantage of this by diving with giant Manta Rays the size of a small plane. programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep111: Sand Tiger Sharks as Protectors

programme.title: Blue World Ep606: The Amazing Comeback of Gray Seals + Shark Performances in the Philippines
programme.desc: Gray seals look like cute swimming puppy dogs, and their story of recovery from the brink of extinction is one of history's best examples of conservation. programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep114: Shark Divers Part 2

programme.title: Liquid Edge Ep110
programme.desc: Liquid Edge examines the subject of surf territorialism and the Aloha Spirit; the beauty and challenge of stand-up paddling in Tahiti; extreme whitewater kayaking. Included is an amazing look behind the scenes of the 3D movie adventure Storm Surfers, plus a spectacular kiteboarding sweet spot.

programme.title: Whales In A Changing Ocean
programme.desc: Wildlife cinematographer Richard Sidey joins an international team of whale research scientists in Antarctica to document their work on how humpback whales adapt to a changing ocean.

programme.title: Travel Quest Ep108: North Pole
programme.desc: The Travel Quest crew takes an icebreaker to the North Pole just in time to make a satellite phone call to wish Bill's mother a happy birthday (she is so shocked she doesn't recognize him). We also track and film the biggest predators on earth…polar bears.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles: In-Depth Look at Brook Trout in West Virginia
programme.desc: We learn about Brook Trout with West Virginia DNR Fisheries Biologist, Brandon Keplinger, TU's Dustin Wichterman, and their children.

programme.title: World of Watersports Ep305: Formula Foil World Championships
programme.desc: The Formula Foil World Championships from Saint Moritz, Switzerland.

programme.title: Blue World Ep507: Sand Tiger Sharks + Marine Biology in Turks & Caicos
programme.desc: Blue World heads to North Carolina to observe how shipwrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing the fish, the sharks are protecting them! Then, we visit the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how to tag sharks!

programme.title: Hot Water Ep104: V8 Jet Sprinting Superboat Championships
programme.desc: Hot Water showcases the world’s best in adrenalized water-related motorsports. This episode features Round 4 of Jet Sprinting from Cabarita in New South Wales, Australia. V8 Unlimited Superboats are the top racing class in Jet Sprinting with the boats being unrestricted.

programme.title: Water Matters Ep101 - Freshwater
programme.desc: Water Matters documents water-related environmental issues from around the globe as a number of the world’s best documentary filmmakers and environmental organizations share their stories regarding the planet’s water crisis as well as potential solutions for a healthier world.

programme.title: Facing Waves Ep507: Paddling The Galapagos Islands
programme.desc: Facing Waves travels to Ecuador to explore the Galapagos Islands - one of the world's most spectacular and biodiverse regions.

programme.title: Next Stop Ep209: Queensland, Australia
programme.desc: Next Stop visits Queensland, Australia and explores The Great Barrier Reef, Cairns Tropical Zoo, the Daintree Discovery Centre and Tjapukai Aboriginal Cultural Park.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep112: Deep White - Why Sharks Attack
programme.desc: Deep White explores ways to research sharks to determine why sharks attack and to study innovative ways to train sharks in order to prevent future attacks. Sharks are surprisingly intelligent and able to perform complex tasks. Sharks can distinguish different signals and cues in feeding routines and they develop strong bonds with their trainers.

programme.title: Xplash Ep110
programme.desc: Xplash brings you amazing action in, on, and near water. In this episode, we travel to the Bahamas and witness a world freediving record, fish for crocodiles with coconuts on a rope, and start the show off by checking out a new evolution in human flight.

programme.title: The Great Barrier Reef: World's most amazing coral reef
programme.desc: This expedition to the Great Barrier Reef is designed to study the health and resilience of one of the world’s most amazing coral reefs. The expedition’s goal is to collect data about the world's most remote reefs and build a picture of how reefs are faring in today's changing climate.

programme.title: Sports Adventure Ep503: The Wellerbrucke Rapids… A Kayaker’s Dream
programme.desc: The Wellerbrucke rapid is a world class kayaker’s dream. Not only offering up great freestyle adventures, it also hosts the Adidas Sick-line Extreme Kayak Championships. This competition is seen through the eyes of 3-time champion Sam Sutton.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep110: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: Mothballed, de-commissioned naval vessels are toxic time-bombs, filled with PCB’s, asbestos, lead paint, oil and grease. Hundreds rust in dockyards around the world. What can be done with them? A team of Canadians has developed an innovative solution…they clean the ships...then sink them!

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures: Kings of Texas
programme.desc: Captain Rick Murphy is on the troll for kingfish in Port Mansfield, Texas. Guiding him to the fish is Captain Chad Kinney from Texas Insider Fishing Report.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep110: Bull Sharks in Cancun, Mexico + Sharks Electrosensory Systems
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV dives with Bull Sharks in Cancun, Mexico and analyzes shark's electrosensory systems.

programme.title: Liquid Edge Ep102
programme.desc: Liquid Edge leaps into canyon pools with the Deap Canyoning Team, captures a first waterfall descent with kayak superstar Steve Fisher, showcases surf cinematographer Larry Haynes, searches the world for secret surf spots via the film Planet Blow, and features an epic swell via Oakley’s Wave of the Winter.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa Ep206: Victoria Falls…The Smoke That Thunders
programme.desc: One of the 7 Natural Wonders of the World, Victoria Falls is an amazing spectacle that straddles the Zambia/Zimbabwe border. The force of the water is so intense that the water bouncing back creates a rainforest. Remarkably, the wildlife in the area is as abundant as the water going over the falls.

programme.title: The Surfing Lifestyle Ep104: In Search of Perfect Waves
programme.desc: A key component of The Surfing Lifestyle is to venture to lesser travelled parts of the world in search of perfect waves, and Dru Adler, Adam Bennetts and their surfboard shaper Daniel MacDonald, did exactly that in southern Sumatra where they found uncrowded perfection and adventure around every turn.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep106: Shark Divers Part 1
programme.desc: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums. Shark Divers focuses on this diverse and eclectic dive group…each with different motives in their fascinating fields.

programme.title: Facing Waves Ep504: Paddling the Swedish-Norwegian Borderlands
programme.desc: Host Heather Herbeck explores the Swedish-Norwegian Borderlands region near Värmland, Sweden on her stand-up paddleboard and competes in a 55K kayak race.

programme.title: Hot Water Ep112: Aquabike World Championship Series
programme.desc: The UIM ABP Aquabike World Championship is in Olbia, Sardinia, for the Grand Prix of Italy, featuring the Aquabike Jetski Division.

programme.title: Travel Quest Ep105: Yap
programme.desc: This remote Pacific island is a diver’s paradise and we take advantage of this by diving with giant Manta Rays the size of a small plane. The craziest dive though is when Bill feeds dozens of sharks with no protective gear. We also film where no one has filmed before…The Forbidden Island.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep111: Sand Tiger Sharks as Protectors
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV demonstrates how Sand Tiger Sharks act as protectors and takes a Deeper Dive by explaining male vs female shark differences, shark reproduction, Gray Reef Sharks and shark buoyancy.

programme.title: World of Watersports Ep315: Cliff Diving, Wing Foiling and Sailing
programme.desc: World of Watersports explores the dangerous sport of Cliff Diving and profiles Gary Hunt - one of the very best cliff divers on the planet. In addition, WOW features wing foiling in Switzerland and Bacardi Cup Sailing in Bermuda.

programme.title: Blue World Ep606: The Amazing Comeback of Gray Seals + Shark Performances in the Philippines
programme.desc: Gray seals look like cute swimming puppy dogs, and their story of recovery from the brink of extinction is one of history's best examples of conservation. Then we travel to the town of Oslob in the Philippines, where the locals have switched from hunting Whale Sharks to teaching them to perform for tourists.

programme.title: Xplash Ep111
programme.desc: The Xplash action is intense as we kayak Africa's Zambezi River, go behind-the-scenes of Australia's V8 Powerboat Racing, and head north to the icy waters of Canada and Alaska for coldwater surfing.

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter: The Fishing Was on FIRE!
programme.desc: Mike got to live out a childhood dream of being a fireman for a day! After taking firefighter, and military veteran, Jeff Latkowski fishing in the kayaks, Jeff showed Mike what it takes to be a firefighter in the agility course that truly tests what you're made of.

programme.title: Next Stop Ep211: Kauai, Hawaii
programme.desc: Next Stop tours Jurassic Park Waterfall (aka Manawaiopuna Falls) via helicopter, kayaks with Outfitters Kauai, and goes tubing with Kauai Backcountry Adventures.

programme.title: Mapping The Blue: World's largest Marine Park
programme.desc: The Cook Islands recently announced the designation of the largest Marine Park on Earth. In stunning 4K imagery, this documentary tells the story of how Kevin Iro, founder of the park, along with his team, use a high tech GIS system to designate multi-use areas inside the pristine park.

programme.title: Sports Adventure Ep510: Kayaking the Remote Sary-Jaz River in China's Tien Shan Mountains
programme.desc: The Sickline Kayaking Team travels to the remote Sary-Jaz River, located in the Tien Shan Mountains, which straddle the borders of China, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan. Expedition leader Tomass Marnics, along with several World Champion kayakers kayak the breathtaking Eyes of God Gorge.

programme.title: Travel Quest Ep110: Botswana
programme.desc: Botswana is a wildlife lover’s dream and it’s also the home of Victoria Falls…the largest waterfalls in the world. Travel Quest's host, Bill Ball, joined a whitewater raft team in order to film the most wild and treacherous rapids in the world. He would not leave unscathed.

programme.title: Water Matters Ep103: Plastics & Pollution
programme.desc: Water Matters documents water-related environmental issues from around the globe as a number of the world’s best documentary filmmakers and environmental organizations share their stories regarding the planet’s water crisis as well as potential solutions for a healthier world.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep112: Hunting for Megalodon Shark Teeth
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV goes on a hunt for Megalodon Shark teeth and takes a Deeper Dive with Megalodon Sharks, Prickly Sharks, and Sand Tiger Sharks.

programme.title: Hot Water Ep122: F1H2O Powerboat World Championship Tour from Evian, France
programme.desc: Round 3 of the UIM F1H2O World Championship Tour was held in Evian, France for a fifth consecutive year as the Grand Prix of France raced on the waters of Lac Leman ("Lake Geneva").

programme.title: Facing Waves Ep603: Paddling Jamaica
programme.desc: Facing Waves host Ken Whiting explores Jamaica’s stunning coastline, mountainous rivers, and epic ocean surf with his sea kayak.

programme.title: World of Watersports Ep320: Kayaking the Muksu River in Tajikistan
programme.desc: World of Watersport highlights the film entitled "The Legend of Muksu", which documents spectacular whitewater kayaking of the Muksu River in Tajikistan.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep114: Shark Divers Part 2
programme.desc: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums. Shark Divers focuses on this diverse and eclectic dive group…each with different motives in their fascinating fields.

programme.desc: Day 4 is about finding balance.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy - Good Morning Joy - Unlocking Happiness
programme.desc: Celebrity hypnotist Tim Shurr helps you unlock happiness and shed anxiety. Shari tests her hypnotizability, and the story of a woman who took back her mental health by empowering women worldwide. Plus, live from Heartfulness headquarters in India.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy - Good Morning Joy - Triumph Over Trauma
programme.desc: 1963 Playboy Icon and Cosby Survivor, Victoria Valentino, shares her journey of overcoming unimaginable circumstances leading her to activism and purpose. Plus, one man's heroic efforts to save a tiny, unconscious life, and fun street interviews from NYC.

programme.title: Life Stories with Marc Hoberman - LSWMH - Armand Mastroianni
programme.desc: Armand Mastroianni talks about his experiences as a young student of film and his journey as a Hollywood director. His body of work speaks volumes to his standing in the entertainment industry.

programme.title: Life Stories with Marc Hoberman - LSWMH - Andrew Lynford
programme.desc: Andrew Lynford talks about his experiences on the hit series Eastenders as well as his years producing and directing.

programme.title: Life Stories with Marc Hoberman - LSWMH - Priscilla Leona
programme.desc: Priscilla Leona talks about her film projects, LA Talk Radio Show and more.

programme.title: The Aware Show - The Aware Show: Dr. James Greenblatt --- Nutritional Solutions in Psychiatry
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. James Greenblatt, a pioneer in the field of integrative medicine who has been treating patients with eating disorders for many decades. His nutritional approach to psychiatry is revolutionary and has helped patients worldwide. He is the author of seven books, including Answers to Anorexia and Finally Focused: The Breakthrough Natural Treatment Plan for ADHD.

programme.title: The Aware Show - The Aware Show: Dr. Cari Schaefer - Feel Better with Optimal Hormone Health
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Cari Schaefer, DACM, an expert in hormones who specializes in fertility and menopause. She is the best-selling author of the book, The Food Solution. As a healthcare expert and provider, educator, and lecturer, she is also the founder of Wise Woman Emerging, a platform designed to midwife women through the menopausal change. She is a Doctor of Traditional Chinese Medicine with more than 21 years of experience.

programme.title: The Aware Show - The Aware Show: Rena Greenberg - Lose Weight Through Hypnosis
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Rena Greenberg, a trained biofeedback therapist and renowned hypnotherapist, who developed Gastric Bypass Hypnosis, a method to transform the way patients think about food, by tapping into the power of the subconscious mind. She is the author of several books, including The Right Weigh and The Easy Sugar Break Up. Rena is passionate about helping others learn how to eat to live, not live to eat and she’s helped hundreds of people reach a healthier weight.

programme.title: The Inspiration Show - Mantras Made Easy With Sherianna Boyle
programme.desc: Sherianna shares how to effectively use mantras and how they can positively influence your thinking and raise your vibration to match your desires.

programme.title: Sex Talk - Sex Talk - How Kissing Can Change Your Sex Life
programme.desc: Are you getting back into the dating game and wondering what to expect? And ever wonder why a kiss leaves you dizzy with desire? Answers to these questions and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.

programme.title: The Rico No Suave Talk Show - The Rico No Suave Talk Show - Juan Antonio Cevallos
programme.desc: Watch the Rico No Suave Talk Show with Juan Antonio Cevllaos as he talks about his awesome acting career and also giving Rico a shoutout for his 5 year Anniversary.

programme.title: The Rico No Suave Talk Show - The Rico No Suave Talk Show - Harold Dennis
programme.desc: The Hyped Actor Harold Dennis, Get to learn more about Dennis that has trained for years under some great teachers and will be giving you insight on how that have helped him become a professional.

programme.title: The Big Flipping Break - A Winner Is Chosen
programme.desc: Glenn and Amber have flipped over 1,000 houses and now they're looking for one lucky contestant to flip a house with. They are passionate about helping everyday people create wealth through real estate investing. So when casting call went out and submissions poured in. Watch as they look for the right partner to not only train but also to completely fund their first deal.

programme.title: The Big Flipping Break - No House, No Flip
programme.desc: David and Alicia have won the contest, but the real game is about to begin. They have to find a house to flip, win Glenn and Amber's trust, and prove they can handle the pressures of house flipping. Because what David and Alicia don't know is that there's an even bigger test going on...Glenn and Amber are looking for more than a single flip, they want long-term investing partners they can fund. If these two newbies can get to pull it off...they are about to get their Big Flipping Break!

programme.title: The Big Flipping Break - What's That Smell?
programme.desc: The team is feeling the pressure as a competitive real estate market threatens to kill the deal before they even get started. Glenn and Amber are starting to worry David and Alicia are in way over their heads.

programme.title: The Big Flipping Break - Surviving a Rollercoaster
programme.desc: David and Alicia don't know they are being judged at every step by Glenn and Amber and the pressure is mounting. While looking for a General Contractor, questions come up about how they're managing the process. David and Alicia start taking demolition matters into their own hands.

programme.title: The Big Flipping Break - The Unwanted Houseguest
programme.desc: The team confronts a problem that could make the entire profit of the job disappear. Watch as David and Alicia try to navigate a surprise visit from an environmental compliance agency.

programme.title: The Big Flipping Break - This House Is A Disaster
programme.desc: Glenn and Amber are in for a surprise of a lifetime and a contractor relationship goes sideways for Alicia and the team must recover fast.

programme.title: The Big Flipping Break - This Might've Been A Big Mistake
programme.desc: David works with Glenn to fix a messy permit issue that could cost thousands and cause weeks of work to be redone. The team is already well over budget and their general contractor problems finally come to a head.

programme.title: The Big Flipping Break - Deal Or No Deal
programme.desc: In the season finale, Alicia complete the staging of the house in hopes they can secure maximum profit. And the big question is finally revealed...will Glenn and Amber want to work with David and Alicia long-term, or just take their profits and move to the next deal.

programme.title: The Rising Man Podcast - How Passive Permission Asking Sabotages Epic Sex with Sarrah Rose & Jeddy Azuma
programme.desc: Sarrah Rose is a men’s coach specialized in tantric activation, sexual healing, and relational mastery. She leads men to re-discover their primal and sacred generative powers, and shares some of her juiciest findings with us.

programme.title: The Rising Man Podcast - Drop The NEED To Control with Kari & Jeddy Azuma
programme.desc: Kari Azuma is a badass leader who guides women in rites of passage journeys and supports new mothers. We address how to navigate periods of low sexual connection, why perpetual overwhelm will create problems, and how to reach shared agreements.

programme.title: The Rising Man Podcast - Own It When You Can’t Hold It with Shems Heartwell & Jeddy Azuma
programme.desc: Shems Heartwell is a qi gong practitioner, acupuncturist, land steward, and men’s work leader. We hit on the areas that men struggle with most including the lone wolf mentality, habitual excuse making, and emotional suppression via substance abuse.

programme.title: The Rising Man Podcast - Flow With The Earth’s Regenerative Cycles with Julian Guderley & Jeddy Azuma
programme.desc: Podcast host, coach, and Earth steward, Julian Guderley is uniquely positioned to connect ancient sustainable principles with living in masculine integrity. We share why love dissipates doubt and how to take responsibility for the world.

programme.title: The Rising Man Podcast - To Live Is To Risk with Kale Ka’alekahi & Jeddy Azuma
programme.desc: Kale Ka’alekahi is a spiritual activist, carrier of indigenous wisdom, and teacher of ancient healing ways. We cover why modern man fears violence, how to transcend the colonial mindset, and why connecting to our ancient roots leads to embodiment.

programme.title: The Rising Man Podcast - Honoring Indigenous Heart Medicine with Ivan Sawyer García & Jeddy Azuma
programme.desc: Ivan Sawyer Garcia is a man deeply committed to preserving indigenous cultures, values, and ways of life. As the founder of Voices of Amerikua, artist, and activist, Ivan explains the dynamics driving colonialism and patriarchy.

This series is about Shawn selecting who he will mentor and teach to reach a level of success they never thought possible. Welcome to the toughest job interview of your life. In this episode, Shawn meets the contestants and immediately finds out who's actually willing to fight for the life they want.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker - Millionaire Maker - Uncomfortable Positions

They have to tell Shawn their story because he wants to know how you got stuck...but more importantly, they have to convince him they won’t give up...no matter how hard it is to hang on, or take a leap of faith.

Just as they were house hunting and talking about raising a family Emily received the news that she had stage 4 lung cancer. She and her husband recall their cancer journey and recount their determination to live life to its fullest while fighting for the chance to have children despite a grave cancer diagnosis.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E1
programme.desc: HOPE IS HERE features inspiring and uplifting, relevant and refreshing, personal stories told by cancer survivors, their families, and the loved ones of those who lost the fight against this “emperor of all maladies” and sparked a movement that gives added meaning to their lives. Their moving stories show how the light of hope is salvaged from depths of despair.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E2
programme.desc: Lung cancer diagnoses for young, non-smoking individuals are a growing trend. But that didn't intimidate the athletic and courageous lung cancer patient, 21-year-old Jill Costello. Jill's fighting spirit and her desire to help find a cure and eradicate the stigma that only smokers contracted the disease would eventually define her legacy.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E3
programme.desc: Hank Baskett was given the grim diagnosis of stage 4 lung cancer almost ten years ago. At the time his thoughts were not of himself but of how he was going to tell his family. In episode 3 of Hope is Here we meet Hank and his family and learn how he was able to push forward towards health with a hopeful attitude and mission that his cancer journey would be, in his words, a joyful one.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E4
programme.desc: Gina Hollenbeck is positive about life. Every day she lives with an optimistic desire to overcome and thrive despite a stage 4 lung cancer diagnosis. As a young mother of two boys, she forges ahead towards a vibrant and meaningful journey with a mission to help find a cure for not only herself but for others who suffer from this deadly disease.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E5
programme.desc: Emily Bennett Taylor and her husband Miles were newlyweds with a bright future planned. Just as they were house hunting and talking about raising a family Emily received the news that she had stage 4 lung cancer. She and her husband recall their cancer journey and recount their determination to live life to its fullest while fighting for the chance to have children despite a grave cancer diagnosis.

programme.title: Hope Is Here - Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E6
programme.desc: Life can be full of hope and dreams. Lisa Briggs was enjoying a successful business, and a close-knit family while celebrating the arrival of her second child. Yet within months of giving birth Lisa was told the devastating news; she had stage 4 lung cancer. For an athletic, young woman who never smoked, the diagnosis seemed unreal. After the shock wore off, Lisa went into full action ahead as her will to live proved stronger than her devastating cancer.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Appreciation is a form of wellness. It’s also what keeps us moving through difficult times and what brings us back to love time and again. More importantly, when you tie your gratitude to the “why” of it, you develop new forms of appreciation and depths of connection for living.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Today, we're going to be talking about opening to joy. Many people, like evolutionary biologists, will say that we are wired to predominantly look for danger, for threats, for what's wrong in our lives, and that it could take some conscious effort, a kind of intentionality, to take in the good and be able to acknowledge it.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Light Watkins
programme.desc: In this lesson with Light Watkins, you will learn to examine bliss as more than a buzzword. You’ll come to see and know it as a powerful state of presence that is accessible through the practice of meditation.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Kimberly Snyder
programme.desc: Today, you will learn how to tap into your unwavering inner knowing, which is also and often called your intuition. Kimberly Synder shares why being connected to your inner source of beauty is so important.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 1
programme.desc: Human biology is a symphony played between the body and the greater nature around us. The great conductor of that symphony, in many ways, is the gut and microbiome. This course will take a multifaceted look at this organ system � which is our primary interface with the chemistry of the world � so you can get an understanding of how to co-create health and well-being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 2
programme.desc: You have an intimate relationship with everything you put in your mouth. The tongue is a magical instrument for you to start to remember the power of flavor and nutrients, to slow it down and experience food again.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 3
programme.desc: The esophagus is simply a tube that runs from mouth to stomach, moving food from one to the other. And yet, as we dig into its structure, we find an extraordinarily complicated and intricate organ that has a deep relationship to the beauty of the body. The reality of this simple tube ends up displaying the sheer miracle of a day in the life of a human being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 4
programme.desc: In terms of its surface area and musculature, the stomach is designed to listen to your food. What is your stomach listening to? It�s listening to how your food was grown, lived, and died. It�s picking up on the microRNA that was in your food right at the moment you consumed it.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 7: Prana
programme.desc: Your Day 7 practice is an invitation right to the good stuff. This fiery session is a warming sequence that guides to you create a healthy flow of energy in the body welcoming total mind and body health.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 9: Bold
programme.desc: Your day 9 practice asks you to check in with body and breath as a way of cultivating more awareness. The journey continues! The vocabulary grows. Move fearlessly through this practice by simply listening to your body. Check your habits and move with intention as a way of moving forward with confidence and focus.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Easing into Back Bending
programme.desc: Establish long term success for your practice by learning about one of the most crucial body parts in yoga—your spine. In this class Schuyler teaches you how to backbend safely, followed by three practical applications. Class ends with a soothing restorative posture. Body awareness never felt so good.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: From Cobra to Camel
programme.desc: This vinyasa class applies what you learned in Day 1 so you can play with classic backbends and steady transitions. Schuyler guides you through Cobra (Bhujangasana), Locust (Salabhasana), and Camel (Ustrasana), finishing off with Bridge (Setu Bandhasana) and spine-clearing twists. Take it slow and build strength!

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Foundations of Forward Bending
programme.desc: In this class, you begin with a brief anatomy of forward folds, followed by a dive into Standing Forward Fold (Uttanasana) and Wide-Legged Forward Fold (Prasarita Padottanasana). Regardless of your flexibility, this lab is designed to help you to safely find length through the entire back chain of your body.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Forward Bending for Forward Thinking
programme.desc: Use what you learned in Day 4 to stretch the hamstrings and your backbody safely and effectively. Bring attention to your spine in Downward Facing Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana) and Intense Side Stretch (Parsvottanasana), before working on Hand-to-Big-Toe Pose (Padangusthasana) with a strap. Finish in a supported backbend to counter your diligent forward folding.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Light Watkins
programme.desc: In this lesson with Light Watkins, you will learn to examine bliss as more than a buzzword. You’ll come to see and know it as a powerful state of presence that is accessible through the practice of meditation.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Kimberly Snyder
programme.desc: Today, you will learn how to tap into your unwavering inner knowing, which is also and often called your intuition. Kimberly Synder shares why being connected to your inner source of beauty is so important.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 1
programme.desc: Human biology is a symphony played between the body and the greater nature around us. The great conductor of that symphony, in many ways, is the gut and microbiome. This course will take a multifaceted look at this organ system � which is our primary interface with the chemistry of the world � so you can get an understanding of how to co-create health and well-being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 2
programme.desc: You have an intimate relationship with everything you put in your mouth. The tongue is a magical instrument for you to start to remember the power of flavor and nutrients, to slow it down and experience food again.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 3
programme.desc: The esophagus is simply a tube that runs from mouth to stomach, moving food from one to the other. And yet, as we dig into its structure, we find an extraordinarily complicated and intricate organ that has a deep relationship to the beauty of the body. The reality of this simple tube ends up displaying the sheer miracle of a day in the life of a human being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 4
programme.desc: In terms of its surface area and musculature, the stomach is designed to listen to your food. What is your stomach listening to? It�s listening to how your food was grown, lived, and died. It�s picking up on the microRNA that was in your food right at the moment you consumed it.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: From Cobra to Camel
programme.desc: This vinyasa class applies what you learned in Day 1 so you can play with classic backbends and steady transitions. programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Foundations of Forward Bending

Finish in a supported backbend to counter your diligent forward folding.
